- [Complete exact function source](https://github.com/mihaiionitabio-alt/zpcrweb/blob/missy-public-offline-2026-10-20/documentation/releases/2026-10-31-full-wiki/code/functions/C08363.js)

```javascript
function mlSolve(A,b){
  const n=A.length,M=A.map((r,i)=>r.concat([b[i]]));
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    let piv=i;for(let r=i+1;r<n;r++)if(Math.abs(M[r][i])>Math.abs(M[piv][i]))piv=r;
    if(Math.abs(M[piv][i])<1e-14)return null;
    [M[i],M[piv]]=[M[piv],M[i]];
    for(let r=0;r<n;r++){if(r===i)continue;const f=M[r][i]/M[i][i];
      for(let c=i;c<=n;c++)M[r][c]-=f*M[i][c];}
  }
  return M.map((r,i)=>r[n]/r[i]);
}
```

- [Complete exact function source](https://github.com/mihaiionitabio-alt/zpcrweb/blob/missy-public-offline-2026-10-20/documentation/releases/2026-10-31-full-wiki/code/functions/C08366.js)

```javascript
function mlMatInv(A){
  const n=A.length,M=A.map((r,i)=>r.concat(Array.from({length:n},(_,j)=>i===j?1:0)));
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    let piv=i;for(let r=i+1;r<n;r++)if(Math.abs(M[r][i])>Math.abs(M[piv][i]))piv=r;
    if(Math.abs(M[piv][i])<1e-14)return null;
    [M[i],M[piv]]=[M[piv],M[i]];
    const d=M[i][i];for(let c=0;c<2*n;c++)M[i][c]/=d;
    for(let r=0;r<n;r++){if(r===i)continue;const f=M[r][i];
      if(!f)continue;for(let c=0;c<2*n;c++)M[r][c]-=f*M[i][c];}
  }
  return M.map(r=>r.slice(n));
}
```

```javascript
function mlBetaCF(a,b,x){
  const MAXIT=300,EPS=3e-16,FPMIN=1e-300;
  const qab=a+b,qap=a+1,qam=a-1;
  let c=1,d=1-qab*x/qap;
  if(Math.abs(d)<FPMIN)d=FPMIN;
  d=1/d;let h=d;
  for(let m=1;m<=MAXIT;m++){
    const m2=2*m;
    let aa=m*(b-m)*x/((qam+m2)*(a+m2));
    d=1+aa*d;if(Math.abs(d)<FPMIN)d=FPMIN;
    c=1+aa/c;if(Math.abs(c)<FPMIN)c=FPMIN;
    d=1/d;h*=d*c;
    aa=-(a+m)*(qab+m)*x/((a+m2)*(qap+m2));
    d=1+aa*d;if(Math.abs(d)<FPMIN)d=FPMIN;
    c=1+aa/c;if(Math.abs(c)<FPMIN)c=FPMIN;
    d=1/d;
    const del=d*c;h*=del;
    if(Math.abs(del-1)<EPS)break;
  }
  return h;
}
```

function mlBetaI(x,a,b){
  if(!(x>0))return 0;
  if(x>=1)return 1;
  const bt=Math.exp(mlLogGamma(a+b)-mlLogGamma(a)-mlLogGamma(b)

```javascript
function mlGammaP(a,x){
  if(x<0||a<=0)return NaN;
  if(x===0)return 0;
  if(x<a+1){                       /* series */
    let ap=a,sum=1/a,del=sum;
    for(let n=1;n<=500;n++){ap++;del*=x/ap;sum+=del;if(Math.abs(del)<Math.abs(sum)*1e-15)break;}
    return sum*Math.exp(-x+a*Math.log(x)-mlLogGamma(a));
  }
  const tiny=1e-300;              /* continued fraction for the upper tail */
  let b=x+1-a,c=1/tiny,d=1/b,h=d;
  for(let i=1;i<=500;i++){
    const an=-i*(i-a);b+=2;d=an*d+b;if(Math.abs(d)<tiny)d=tiny;
    c=b+an/c;if(Math.abs(c)<tiny)c=tiny;d=1/d;const del=d*c;h*=del;
    if(Math.abs(del-1)<1e-15)break;
  }
  return 1-Math.exp(-x+a*Math.log(x)-mlLogGamma(a))*h;
}
```

```javascript
function mlPolyFit(x,y,degree){
  const n=x.length,p=degree+1;
  if(n<p+2)return null;
  const row=xv=>Array.from({length:p},(_,i)=>Math.pow(xv,i));
  const A=Array.from({length:p},(_,i)=>Array.from({length:p},(_,j)=>
    x.reduce((s,xv)=>s+Math.pow(xv,i+j),0)));
  const b=Array.from({length:p},(_,i)=>x.reduce((s,xv,k)=>s+Math.pow(xv,i)*y[k],0));
  const c=mlSolve(A,b),Ainv=mlMatInv(A);
  if(!c||!Ainv)return null;
  const fit=xv=>c.reduce((s,ci,i)=>s+ci*Math.pow(xv,i),0);
  const resid=y.map((yv,i)=>yv-fit(x[i]));
  const rss=resid.reduce((s,r)=>s+r*r,0),dof=n-p;
  if(dof<1)return null;
  const sigma=Math.sqrt(rss/dof);
  const yMean=mlMean(y),tss=y.reduce((s,v)=>s+(v-yMean)*(v-yMean),0);
  /* k = coefficients + residual variance */
  const k=p+1,aicc=n-k-1>0?n*Math.log(Math.max(rss/n,1e-300))+2*k+2*k*(k+1)/(n-k-1):Infinity;
  return {coef:c,degree,p,fit,resid,sigma,rss,aicc,r2:tss>0?1-rss/tss:NaN,n,dof,
          lev:xv=>mlQuad(row(xv),Ainv),Ainv};
}
```

```javascript
function mlIndependence(resid){
  const n=resid.length;
  if(n<12)return {n,ok:null,why:"too few residuals to test"};
  const m=mlMean(resid),dev=resid.map(v=>v-m);
  const c0=dev.reduce((s,v)=>s+v*v,0);
  if(!(c0>0))return {n,ok:null,why:"residuals are identical"};
  const h=Math.max(1,Math.min(10,Math.floor(n/5)));
  const r=[];
  for(let k=1;k<=h;k++){let s=0;for(let i=k;i<n;i++)s+=dev[i]*dev[i-k];r.push(s/c0);}
  const Q=n*(n+2)*r.reduce((s,rk,i)=>s+rk*rk/(n-(i+1)),0);
  const p=mlChi2Upper(Q,h);
  return {n,r1:r[0],lags:h,Q,df:h,p,ok:p>=0.05,
          se:1/Math.sqrt(n),why:p>=0.05?"":"residuals are autocorrelated"};
}
```

```javascript
function mlForecast(x,y,ahead,opts){
  const o=opts||{};
  const ok=x.map((v,i)=>[v,y[i]]).filter(q=>Number.isFinite(q[0])&&Number.isFinite(q[1]));
  if(ok.length<8)return null;
  const xs=ok.map(q=>q[0]),ys=ok.map(q=>q[1]);
  /* scale to [0,1]: the page's x axis can be a cycle counter in the tens of
     thousands, and its square ruins the conditioning of the normal equations */
  const x0=xs[0],sx=(xs[xs.length-1]-x0)||1;
  const xn=xs.map(v=>(v-x0)/sx);
  const cands=[mlPolyFit(xn,ys,1)];
  if(ok.length>=12)cands.push(mlPolyFit(xn,ys,2));
  const fits=cands.filter(Boolean).sort((a,b)=>a.degree-b.degree);
  if(!fits.length)return null;
  /* Parsimony with a stated rule. Minimum AICc alone flips between a line and
     a curve on differences of a few tenths, which is noise, and the panel would
     then announce curvature that the data does not establish. The simpler model
     is kept unless a richer one improves AICc by at least 2 -- the conventional
     threshold for "better supported" -- and the margin is reported. */
  const MARGIN=2;
  let m=fits[0];
  for(let i=1;i<fits.length;i++)if(fits[i].aicc<=m.aicc-MARGIN)m=fits[i];
  const margin=fits.length>1?Math.min(...fits.filter(f=>f!==m).map(f=>f.aicc))-m.aicc:NaN;
  const name=f=>f.degree===1?"linear":"quadratic";
  mlTrace(`forecast on ${ok.length} runs · candidates `
    +fits.map(f=>`${name(f)} AICc ${f.aicc.toFixed(3)} R² ${Number.isFinite(f.r2)?f.r2.toFixed(4):"—"}`).join(" · ")
    +` → chose ${name(m)} (simplest unless AICc improves by ${MARGIN}), residual spread ${m.sigma.toExponential(3)}, ${m.dof} dof`);
  const ind=mlIndependence(m.resid);
  mlTrace(`  independence screen · lag-1 r ${Number.isFinite(ind.r1)?ind.r1.toFixed(4):"—"}`
    +` · Ljung-Box Q ${Number.isFinite(ind.Q)?ind.Q.toFixed(3):"—"} on ${ind.lags||0} lags`
    +` · p ${Number.isFinite(ind.p)?ind.p.toFixed(4):"—"} → ${ind.ok===null?"not tested":ind.ok?"no evidence against independence":"AUTOCORRELATED, interval withheld"}`);
  /* future spacing: the median step of the observed x, stated to the reader,
     because five runs ahead on a date or hour axis assumes future spacing */
  const d=[];for(let i=1;i<xn.length;i++)d.push(xn[i]-xn[i-1]);
  const step=mlMedian(d)||1/Math.max(1,xn.length-1);
  const tq=mlTinv(0.975,m.dof);
  const pts=[];
  for(let k=1;k<=(ahead||5);k++){
    const xf=xn[xn.length-1]+k*step;
    const se=m.sigma*Math.sqrt(1+m.lev(xf));
    const half=tq*se;
    pts.push({x:x0+xf*sx,y:m.fit(xf),lo:m.fit(xf)-half,hi:m.fit(xf)+half,se,half});
  }
  return {model:name(m),degree:m.degree,r2:m.r2,sigma:m.sigma,n:m.n,dof:m.dof,
          aicc:fits.map(f=>({model:name(f),aicc:f.aicc,r2:f.r2})),
          selectionMargin:margin,selectionRule:`simplest model unless AICc improves by ${MARGIN}`,
          tQuantile:tq,independence:ind,intervalReliable:ind.ok!==false,
          stepX:step*sx,points:pts,inSample:xn.map(v=>({x:x0+v*sx,y:m.fit(v)})),
          unitKind:o.unitKind||""};
}
```

```javascript
function mlWeightedDraw(w,u){
  const sum=w.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
  if(!(sum>0))return 0;
  let r=u*sum;
  for(let i=0;i<w.length-1;i++){
    if(r<w[i])return i;
    r-=w[i];
  }
  return w.length-1;
}
```

```javascript
function mlKMeans(points,k,seed){
  const rng=mlRng(seed||777),n=points.length;
  if(n<k*3||k<1)return null;
  const centres=[points[Math.floor(rng()*n)].slice()];
  while(centres.length<k){
    const d2=points.map(p=>Math.pow(Math.min(...centres.map(c=>mlDist(p,c))),2));
    centres.push(points[mlWeightedDraw(d2,rng())].slice());
  }
  let assign=new Array(n).fill(0);
  mlTrace(`k-means: ${n} runs, ${k} group(s), seeded k-means++ start`);
  for(let it=0;it<60;it++){
    let moved=false,moves=0;
    for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
      let best=0,bd=Infinity;
      centres.forEach((c,j)=>{const d=mlDist(points[i],c);if(d<bd){bd=d;best=j;}});
      if(assign[i]!==best){assign[i]=best;moved=true;moves++;}
    }
    if(ML_TRACE){
      const inertia=points.reduce((s,pt,i)=>s+Math.pow(mlDist(pt,centres[assign[i]]),2),0);
      mlTrace(`  pass ${it+1} · ${moves} run(s) reassigned · within-group sum of squares ${inertia.toFixed(4)}`);
    }
    for(let j=0;j<k;j++){
      const mem=points.filter((_,i)=>assign[i]===j);
      if(mem.length)centres[j]=mem[0].map((_,d)=>mlMean(mem.map(m=>m[d])));
    }
    if(!moved)break;
  }
  const sizes=centres.map((_,j)=>assign.filter(a=>a===j).length);
  const inertia=points.reduce((s,pt,i)=>s+Math.pow(mlDist(pt,centres[assign[i]]),2),0);
  mlTrace("  settled · group sizes",sizes);
  return {assign,centres,sizes,inertia,k,silhouette:mlSilhouette(points,assign,k)};
}
```

```javascript
function mlSilhouette(points,assign,k){
  const n=points.length;
  if(k<2)return NaN;                        /* undefined for a single group */
  if(assign.some(a=>a==null))return NaN;
  const sizes=Array.from({length:k},(_,j)=>assign.filter(a=>a===j).length);
  if(sizes.some(s=>s===0))return NaN;
  let total=0;
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const own=sizes[assign[i]];
    if(own<2){continue;}                    /* a singleton contributes 0 */
    let a=0;const b=new Array(k).fill(0);
    for(let j=0;j<n;j++){
      if(i===j)continue;const d=mlDist(points[i],points[j]);
      if(assign[j]===assign[i])a+=d;else b[assign[j]]+=d;
    }
    a/=own-1;
    let bb=Infinity;
    for(let j=0;j<k;j++)if(j!==assign[i]&&sizes[j]>0)bb=Math.min(bb,b[j]/sizes[j]);
    const m=Math.max(a,bb);
    total+=m>0?(bb-a)/m:0;
  }
  return total/n;
}
```

```javascript
function mlClusterStructure(points,seed,kMax,nNull){
  const n=points.length;
  if(n<12)return {structure:false,why:"fewer than twelve runs"};
  const dims=points[0].length;
  const lo=Array.from({length:dims},(_,d)=>Math.min(...points.map(p=>p[d])));
  const hi=Array.from({length:dims},(_,d)=>Math.max(...points.map(p=>p[d])));
  const best=(pts,sd)=>{
    let b=null;
    for(let k=2;k<=Math.min(kMax||4,Math.floor(n/3));k++){
      const km=mlKMeans(pts,k,sd+k);
      if(km&&Number.isFinite(km.silhouette)&&(!b||km.silhouette>b.silhouette))b=km;
    }
    return b;
  };
  const obs=best(points,seed||4242);
  if(!obs)return {structure:false,why:"too few runs to form groups"};
  const rng=mlRng((seed||4242)+99),nulls=[];
  for(let s=0;s<(nNull||20);s++){
    const sample=Array.from({length:n},()=>Array.from({length:dims},(_,d)=>lo[d]+rng()*(hi[d]-lo[d])));
    const b=best(sample,(seed||4242)+1000+s);
    if(b&&Number.isFinite(b.silhouette))nulls.push(b.silhouette);
  }
  const q90=nulls.length?mlQuantile(nulls,0.9):NaN;
  const structure=Number.isFinite(q90)&&obs.silhouette>q90;
  mlTrace(`cluster structure · best k ${obs.k} · silhouette ${obs.silhouette.toFixed(4)}`
    +` · null 90th percentile ${Number.isFinite(q90)?q90.toFixed(4):"—"} → ${structure?"structure":"no more than chance"}`);
  return {structure,km:obs,k:obs.k,silhouette:obs.silhouette,nullQ90:q90,nNull:nulls.length};
}
```

```javascript
function mlFitLogistic(z,yLab,iters,lr,L2,tag){
  const n=z.length,p=z[0].length;
  let w=new Array(p).fill(0),b=0;
  const total=iters||400;
  mlTrace(`logistic regression${tag?" ("+tag+")":""}: ${n} runs, ${p} metrics, ${yLab.filter(v=>v===1).length} flagged, lr ${lr}, L2 ${L2}, ${total} steps`);
  for(let it=0;it<total;it++){
    const gw=new Array(p).fill(0);let gb=0,loss=0;
    for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
      const s=z[i].reduce((acc,v,j)=>acc+v*w[j],0)+b;
      const pr=1/(1+Math.exp(-Math.max(-30,Math.min(30,s))));
      const e=pr-yLab[i];
      for(let j=0;j<p;j++)gw[j]+=e*z[i][j];
      gb+=e;
      if(ML_TRACE)loss-=yLab[i]?Math.log(Math.max(pr,1e-12)):Math.log(Math.max(1-pr,1e-12));
    }
    /* the objective is reported, never acted on: no early stop, so the step
       count is fixed and the result stays deterministic */
    if(ML_TRACE&&(it%50===0||it===total-1)){
      const gn=Math.sqrt(gw.reduce((a,g)=>a+(g/n)*(g/n),0)+(gb/n)*(gb/n));
      mlTrace(`  step ${String(it+1).padStart(4)} · mean log-loss ${(loss/n).toFixed(6)} · gradient norm ${gn.toExponential(3)}`);
    }
    for(let j=0;j<p;j++)w[j]-=lr*(gw[j]/n+L2*w[j]/n);
    b-=lr*gb/n;
  }
  return {w,b};
}
```

```javascript
function overviewData(){
 if(OVERVIEW_CACHE.runs===RUNS&&OVERVIEW_CACHE.count===RUNS.length&&OVERVIEW_CACHE.revision===SAMPLE_SELECTION.revision&&OVERVIEW_CACHE.generation===APP_STATE.generation)return OVERVIEW_CACHE.value;
 const groups=new Map(),runRows=[],points=[];
 function add(run,ri,w,q,basis,target,channel,protocol){
  if(!Number.isFinite(q)||q<=0)return;
  const sn=run.meta.SerialNumber||run.meta.InstrumentID||'',knownProtocol=protocol&&!/not decoded|unknown protocol/i.test(protocol);
  const identity=sn||'Unverified SN; source '+run.meta.sourceSHA256;
  const fingerprint=knownProtocol?sha256Hex(new TextEncoder().encode(protocol)):'Unverified protocol; source '+run.meta.sourceSHA256;
  const key=JSON.stringify([run.reader?.id||run.platform||'',identity,fingerprint,target||'Unassigned',String(channel??''),basis,w.analysis||w.analysisMode||'',w.overviewTargetVerified===false?run.meta.sourceSHA256:'']);
  if(!groups.has(key))groups.set(key,{key,instrument:identity,protocol:fingerprint,target:target||'Unassigned',channel:String(channel??''),basis,analysis:w.analysis||w.analysisMode||'',points:[]});
  const row={run_index:ri+1,filename:run.file,source_sha256:run.meta.sourceSHA256,well:w.well||posToWell(w.pos,run.cols),sample:w.sample||'',role:w.role||w.instrRole||'Unknown',value:q,run};groups.get(key).points.push(row);points.push(row);
 }
 RUNS.forEach((run,ri)=>{
  const selected=ssWells(run),stored=selected.filter(w=>Number.isFinite(sopCq(w))),protocol=overviewProtocol(run);
  for(const w of stored)add(run,ri,w,sopCq(w),'Stored vendor Cq',w.target||w.analysis||'Unassigned',w.filterComb||w.channel,protocol);
  let independent=0;
  if(run.pcrd)for(const group of piResults(run).groups)for(const r of group.records){if(!ssPositionIncluded(run,r.layout.position)||!Number.isFinite(r.cq.value)||r.cq.value<=0)continue;independent++;add(run,ri,{pos:r.layout.position,well:r.layout.well,sample:r.layout.sample,role:r.layout.role,analysis:PCRDI_METHOD+' | acquisition group '+group.step,overviewTargetVerified:!!r.layout.target?.trim()},r.cq.value,'Independently calculated PCRD Cq',r.layout.target?.trim()||'Unassigned target ('+group.dye+')',group.dye+' / raw channel '+(group.channel+1),run.pcrd.protocolSHA256);}
  runRows.push({run:'R'+(ri+1),filename:run.file,format:run.reader?.id||'',selected_results:selected.length,stored_Cq:stored.length,without_Cq:selected.length-stored.length,excluded_results:(run.wells||[]).length-selected.length,independent_Cq:independent,raw_reads:(run.zpcr||run.pcrd)?.reads.length||0});
 });
 const cohorts=[...groups.values()].map((g,i)=>({...g,id:'C'+(i+1)})),stats=[];
 for(const g of cohorts)for(const [role,rows]of byKey(g.points,x=>x.role)){
  const a=rows.map(r=>r.value).sort((a,b)=>a-b);stats.push({cohort:g.id,role,n:a.length,mean:mean(a),median:median(a),SD:a.length>1?sd(a):null,min:a[0],max:a.at(-1)});
 }
 const result={cohorts,stats,runRows,points};OVERVIEW_CACHE.runs=RUNS;OVERVIEW_CACHE.count=RUNS.length;OVERVIEW_CACHE.revision=SAMPLE_SELECTION.revision;OVERVIEW_CACHE.generation=APP_STATE.generation;OVERVIEW_CACHE.value=result;return result;
}
```

function cfxFigure(r,metric){if(metric==='plate'){const f=GRAPHS.find(x=>x.id==='plate').render({run:r,target:'',metric:'cq'});return {...f,rows:[]};}const ws=ssWells(r),series=[],rows=[],rowColors=new Map();let title='',unit='',xlab='Physical well index (row-major)';const colors=['#2563eb','#e11d48','#059669','#9333ea','#b45309','#0891b2'];
 if(metric==='amp'||metric==='melt'){title=metric==='amp'?'Processed amplification curves':'Exported melt signal';unit='Exported fluorescence';xlab=metric==='amp'?'Exported cycle number':'Stored temperature (°C)';for(const w of ws){const a=metric==='amp'?w.rdml.amplification:w.rdml.melt;if(a.length>1)series.push({type:'line',data:a,colour:catColour(rowColors,'Plate row '+String.fromCharCode(65+w.row)),opacity:.55,label:w.well,tip:w.well+' · '+w.sample});}}
 else {title=metric==='cq'?'Vendor Cq by well':'Processed endpoint · last '+ZPCR_ENDPOINT_N+' reads';unit=metric==='cq'?'Vendor-exported Cq':'Mean exported fluorescence';for(const w of ws){let v=w.Cp;if(metric==='endpoint'){const a=w.rdml.amplification.slice(-ZPCR_ENDPOINT_N);v=a.length===ZPCR_ENDPOINT_N?a.reduce((s,p)=>s+p[1],0)/a.length:null;}if(Number.isFinite(v))rows.push({well:w.well,sample:w.sample,target:w.target,value:v});}series.push({data:rows.map(v=>[ws.find(w=>w.well===v.well).pos+1,v.value,v.well+' · '+v.sample]),colour:colors[0],r:3});}
 const pts=series.flatMap(s=>s.data).filter(p=>p.every((x,i)=>i>1||Number.isFinite(x))),xs=pts.map(p=>p[0]),ys=pts.map(p=>p[1]);let lo=Math.min(...ys),hi=Math.max(...ys),pad=(hi-lo)*.07||1;return {svg:svgPlot({width:1000,height:530,title,x:xs.length?[Math.min(...xs),Math.max(...xs)]:[0,1],y:ys.length?[lo-pad,hi+pad]:[0,1],xlab,ylab:unit,series,legend:legendFromMap(rowColors),right:rowColors.size?145:25}),rows:[]};
}

}

```javascript
function pcrdImportFeedback(){
 for(const el of document.querySelectorAll('.pcrd-import-feedback'))el.remove();
 const decoded=pcrdRuns(),locked=RUNS.filter(r=>r.pcrdLocked);if(!decoded.length&&!locked.length)return;
 for(const id of ['tab-load','tab-results','tab-panel','tab-review']){
  const parent=document.getElementById(id);if(!parent)continue;
  const box=document.createElement('div');box.className='pcrd-import-feedback';box.style.cssText='margin:16px 0;padding:16px;border:1px solid #4087cf;border-radius:8px;overflow-wrap:anywhere';
  const title=document.createElement('strong');title.textContent=decoded.length?'PCRD measurements decoded / PCRD 测量数据已解码':'PCRD locked: no measurements decoded / PCRD 已锁定：尚未解码测量数据';box.append(title);
  const p=document.createElement('p');p.textContent=decoded.length?`${decoded.length} PCRD files; ${decoded.reduce((n,r)=>n+r.pcrd.reads.length,0)} stored acquisition reads; ${pcrdItems().length} figures. “0 stored results” means no imported vendor Cq/Tm result table; raw readings and independent calculations are separate. / “0 个存储结果”不表示没有原始测量数据。`:'These are source inventories only. Return to Load files and read again with the correct password, or import a CFX RDML export. / 当前仅有文件清单。请返回加载页，使用正确密码重新读取，或导入 CFX 导出的 RDML。';box.append(p);
  if(locked.length&&decoded.length){const warning=document.createElement('p');warning.textContent=locked.length+' additional encrypted files remain unavailable.';box.append(warning);}
  function button(label,fn){const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.textContent=label;b.style.margin='4px 8px 4px 0';b.onclick=fn;box.append(b);}
  if(decoded.length){button('Open PCRD graphs / 打开 PCRD 图表',()=>{pcrdSync();unifiedBrowse(pcrdItems()[0]?.id);});if(typeof piItems==='function'&&piItems().length){button('Independent Cq/Tm graphs / 独立计算图表',()=>unifiedBrowse(piItems()[0].id));button('Download independent values (CSV) / 下载独立计算值',()=>download('PCRD_independent_Cq_Tm.csv',pcrdCSV(decoded.flatMap(r=>piResults(r).rows)),'text/csv'));}}
  if(decoded.length&&id==='tab-results'){
   const wrap=document.createElement('div');wrap.style.cssText='max-height:420px;overflow:auto;margin-top:12px';
   const table=document.createElement('table');table.style.cssText='width:100%;table-layout:auto';
   const head=document.createElement('tr');for(const text of ['Source file / 文件','Instrument SN','Acquisition reads / 采集读数','Independent Cq calls / 独立 Cq']){const th=document.createElement('th');th.textContent=text;head.append(th);}table.append(head);
   for(const r of decoded){const tr=document.createElement('tr');for(const text of [r.file,r.meta.SerialNumber||'Unavailable',r.pcrd.reads.length,typeof piResults==='function'?piResults(r).rows.filter(x=>Number.isFinite(x.Cq_independent)).length:'Unavailable']){const td=document.createElement('td');td.textContent=String(text);td.style.overflowWrap='anywhere';tr.append(td);}table.append(tr);}wrap.append(table);box.append(wrap);
   if(typeof piResults==='function'){const details=document.createElement('details');details.open=true;const summary=document.createElement('summary');summary.textContent='Independent calculated records / 独立计算记录';details.append(summary);const scroll=document.createElement('div');scroll.style.cssText='max-height:360px;overflow:auto';const t=document.createElement('table');const h=document.createElement('tr');for(const text of ['File','Well','Sample','Raw channel','Cq (independent)','Tm °C (independent)']){const th=document.createElement('th');th.textContent=text;h.append(th);}t.append(h);for(const row of decoded.flatMap(r=>piResults(r).rows).filter(x=>Number.isFinite(x.Cq_independent)||Number.isFinite(x.Tm_independent_C))){const tr=document.createElement('tr');for(const text of [row.source_file,row.well,row.sample,row.channel,Number.isFinite(row.Cq_independent)?row.Cq_independent.toFixed(3):'Unavailable',Number.isFinite(row.Tm_independent_C)?row.Tm_independent_C.toFixed(3):'Unavailable']){const td=document.createElement('td');td.textContent=String(text??'');td.style.overflowWrap='anywhere';tr.append(td);}t.append(tr);}scroll.append(t);details.append(scroll);box.append(details);}
  }
  parent.prepend(box);
 }
}
```

function zcPlot(p,x,y){const L=x+62,T=y+58,W=468,H=155,ss=p.series,pts=ss.flatMap(s=>s.points.filter(v=>Number.isFinite(v[0])&&Number.isFinite(v[1])));let svg=`<text x="${x+10}" y="${y+22}" font-size="18" font-weight="bold">${esc(p.title)}</text><text x="${x+10}" y="${y+43}" font-size="14" fill="#526273">${esc(p.unit)}</text>`;if(!pts.length)return svg+`<text x="${x+20}" y="${y+100}" font-size="16">Unavailable: complete window / values absent</text>`;
 let a=Math.min(...pts.map(v=>v[0])),b=Math.max(...pts.map(v=>v[0])),lo=Math.min(...pts.map(v=>v[1])),hi=Math.max(...pts.map(v=>v[1]));if(p.bars){a=.5;b=6.5;lo=Math.min(0,lo);}if(a===b){a-=.5;b+=.5;}if(lo===hi){lo-=Math.max(1,Math.abs(lo)*.05);hi+=Math.max(1,Math.abs(hi)*.05);}const pad=(hi-lo)*.06;lo-=pad;hi+=pad;const X=v=>L+(v-a)/(b-a)*W,Y=v=>T+H-(v-lo)/(hi-lo)*H,F=v=>Math.abs(v)>=10000||Math.abs(v)>0&&Math.abs(v)<.001?v.toExponential(1):String(+v.toPrecision(4));
 for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const v=lo+(hi-lo)*i/3;svg+=`<path d="M${L} ${Y(v)}h${W}" stroke="#dce3eb"/><text x="${L-7}" y="${Y(v)+5}" text-anchor="end" font-size="14">${F(v)}</text>`;}svg+=`<path d="M${L} ${T}v${H}h${W}" fill="none" stroke="#738399"/>`;
 for(let i=0;i<(p.bars?6:4);i++){const v=p.bars?i+1:a+(b-a)*i/3;svg+=`<text x="${X(v)}" y="${T+H+23}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14">${p.bars?'Ch '+v:F(v)}</text>`;}svg+=`<text x="${L+W/2}" y="${T+H+44}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14">${esc(p.xlabel||'Read order within step')}</text>`;
 for(const s of ss){const color=ZC_COLORS[s.channel],valid=s.points.filter(v=>Number.isFinite(v[0])&&Number.isFinite(v[1]));if(p.bars){const bw=W/6/Math.max(1,p.runs)*.65;for(const v of valid){const bx=X(v[0])+(s.run-(p.runs-1)/2)*bw,zero=Y(0),py=Y(v[1]);svg+=`<rect x="${bx-bw/2}" y="${Math.min(zero,py)}" width="${bw}" height="${Math.max(1,Math.abs(zero-py))}" fill="${color}" opacity="${s.run%2?.45:.9}"/>`;}}else{let path='',open=false;for(const v of s.points){if(!Number.isFinite(v[0])||!Number.isFinite(v[1])){open=false;continue;}path+=(open?'L':'M')+X(v[0])+' '+Y(v[1])+' ';open=true;}svg+=`<path d="${path}" fill="none" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="${s.run%2?'7 4':''}"/>`;if(valid.length===1)svg+=`<text x="${L+8}" y="${T+20+16*s.channel}" font-size="13" fill="${color}">${esc(s.label||('Ch '+(s.channel+1)))}: one value (${F(valid[0][1])})</text>`;}}
 return svg;
}

function zcFigure(g,step,family){const rr=g.runs.map(run=>({run,reads:run.zpcr.reads.filter(r=>r.step===step)})).filter(x=>x.reads.length),panels=[],add=(title,unit,series,opts={})=>panels.push({title,unit,series,...opts}),ch=fn=>rr.flatMap((x,i)=>Array.from({length:x.reads[0].channels},(_,c)=>({run:i,channel:c,points:x.reads.map((r,j)=>[j+1,fn(r,c,x.run)])}))),ref=(r,c,run)=>ZPCR.zpcrStats(Array.from({length:run.zpcr.grid.referenceRows*r.cols},(_,i)=>ZPCR.zpcrWellMean(r,c,run.zpcr.grid.sampleRows+Math.floor(i/r.cols),i%r.cols)))?.mean;
 if(family==='optical'){
 add('Raw fluorescence · A1','Raw instrument units',ch((r,c)=>ZPCR.zpcrWellMean(r,c,0,0)));add('Optical reference row','Raw instrument units',ch(ref));add('Stored dark mean','Raw detector counts',ch((r,c)=>r.darkData?.[c*4]));add('LED DAC setting','Configuration setting; not measured mA',ch((r,c)=>r.leds[c]));
 const drift=fn=>rr.flatMap((x,i)=>Array.from({length:x.reads[0].channels},(_,c)=>{const first=fn(x.reads[0],c,x.run);return {run:i,channel:c,points:x.reads.map((r,j)=>[j+1,first===0?NaN:100*(fn(r,c,x.run)/first-1)])};}));add('Dark change from first read','%; zero denominator withheld',drift((r,c)=>r.darkData?.[c*4]));add('Reference change from first read','%; zero denominator withheld',drift(ref));
 }else if(family==='hardware'){
 const fields=['BLOCKTEMP','SAMPLETEMP','LIDTEMP','SHUTTLETEMP','AMBIENTTEMP'];add('Temperature fields at reads','°C; inferred field meanings / ambient caveats',rr.flatMap((x,i)=>fields.map((f,c)=>({run:i,channel:c,points:x.reads.map((r,j)=>[j+1,r.temps[f]?.c])}))));add('Stored dark SD','Raw counts; not temporal detector-noise SD',ch((r,c)=>r.darkData?.[c*4+1]));add('Stored dark max minus min','Raw counts; maxima depend on read count',ch((r,c)=>(r.darkData?.[c*4+3]??NaN)-(r.darkData?.[c*4+2]??NaN)));
 add('Read intervals','Seconds; timestamp resolution 1 s',rr.map((x,i)=>({run:i,channel:0,label:'R'+(i+1),points:x.reads.slice(1).map((r,j)=>[j+2,(r.epochMs-x.reads[j].epochMs)/1000])})));add('Ordered block-temperature increments','°C/read; holds and cooling are legitimate',rr.map((x,i)=>({run:i,channel:0,label:'R'+(i+1),points:x.reads.slice(1).map((r,j)=>[j+2,r.temps.BLOCKTEMP?.c-x.reads[j].temps.BLOCKTEMP?.c])})));
 add('Reference versus stored factory value','% deviation; separate reference positions',rr.flatMap((x,i)=>{const q=ZPCR.zpcrQcMetrics(x.run.zpcr,step).metrics.referenceVsFactory;return Array.from({length:x.reads[0].channels},(_,c)=>({run:i,channel:c,points:(q?.byChannel?.[c]||[]).map((v,j)=>[j+1,v.deviationPct??NaN])}));}),{xlabel:'Stored reference position'});
 }else{

function zcReportItems(selected){const zp=selected.filter(x=>/^cc:z_/.test(x.id));if(!zp.length)return selected;const ids=new Set(zp.map(x=>x.id.slice(3))),all=ids.size===23,result=selected.filter(x=>!/^cc:z_/.test(x.id)),families=[['optical','Raw optical channel comparisons',['z_dark','z_dark_drift','z_reference','z_ref_drift','z_led']],['hardware','Hardware / sampling comparisons',['z_block','z_block_sd','z_sample','z_lid','z_shuttle','z_ambient','z_dark_sdmax','z_dark_spanmax','z_interval','z_interval_sd','z_factory','z_spacing','z_nonincrease','z_gapmax']],['endpoint','Endpoint / early-window comparisons',['z_endpoint_mean','z_endpoint_span','z_early_slope','z_early_residual']]];let n=0;

```javascript
function zpcrContributions(){
 const groups=new Map(),result=new Map();for(const run of RUNS.filter(r=>r.zpcr)){const e=run.zpcr.evidence,k=e?.acquisitionSHA256||run.meta.sourceSHA256;if(!groups.has(k))groups.set(k,[]);groups.get(k).push(run);}
 for(const [key,members]of groups){members.sort((a,b)=>a.meta.sourceSHA256.localeCompare(b.meta.sourceSHA256));const signatures=new Set(members.map(r=>JSON.stringify([r.zpcr.evidence?.baseSerial,r.meta.ZPCRProtocolSHA256,r.meta.StartTime,r.meta.InstrumentVersion]))),conflict=signatures.size>1;
 const good=conflict?[]:members.filter(r=>r.zpcr.evidence?.completionSupported),representative=good[0];
 for(const r of members){const e=r.zpcr.evidence;result.set(r,{eligible:r===representative,completionSupported:!!e?.completionSupported&&!conflict,acquisitionSHA256:key,duplicateOf:representative&&r!==representative?representative.meta.sourceSHA256:'',sourceAliases:members.map(a=>({file:a.file,sourceSHA256:a.meta.sourceSHA256})),status:conflict?'REVIEW: identical acquisitions have conflicting run identity/protocol metadata':!e?.completionSupported?(e?.status||'REVIEW: legacy data lacks verification'):r===representative?'One completed acquisition contribution':representative?'Duplicate acquisitions: retained as source evidence, excluded from independent baseline':'REVIEW: no eligible contribution'});}
 }
 return result;
}
```

## C08902 · zpcrGuideMetrics

- Ownership: MISSY first-party
- Module: core/biorad/zpcr_guide_charts.js, line 2; script 11, script line 815
- Form: FunctionDeclaration; parameters: `run`
- AST classification: `new_named`
- R1 entry status: `observed_in_passing_scenario`
- Passing scenario observations: formats, evidence-keyboard
- R2 clean contract evidence: No separately linked clean contract assertion for this function
- Code SHA-256: `f36a0891946caf4d2de60dfceac7811e6b5ab69eebf31c48447ca3691084a4da`
- [Complete exact function source](https://github.com/mihaiionitabio-alt/zpcrweb/blob/missy-public-offline-2026-10-20/documentation/releases/2026-10-31-full-wiki/code/functions/C08902.js)

```javascript
function zpcrGuideMetrics(run){
 const out={},put=(id,v,n)=>{if(Number.isFinite(n))(out[id]||(out[id]={}))[v]=n;},z=run.zpcr;
 for(const step of new Set(z.reads.map(r=>r.step))){
  const reads=z.reads.filter(r=>r.step===step),tag='Step '+step;
  // Keep source order, including non-increasing samples; never sort by temperature.
  const ts=reads.map(r=>r.temps.BLOCKTEMP?.c),ds=ts.slice(1).map((t,i)=>t-ts[i]);
  if(ts.length>1&&ts.every(Number.isFinite)){
   put('z_spacing',tag,ZPCR.zpcrStats(ds).mean);
   put('z_nonincrease',tag,ds.filter(d=>d<=0).length);
   put('z_gapmax',tag,Math.max(...ds.map(Math.abs)));
  }
  for(const [lo,hi]of [[2,6],[2,10]]){
   // Explicit cycle windows; missing/repeated cycle values withhold the metric.
   const window=reads.filter(r=>r.cycle>=lo&&r.cycle<=hi);
   if(window.length!==hi-lo+1||window.some((r,i)=>r.cycle!==lo+i))continue;
   for(let c=0;c<reads[0].channels;c++)for(let p=0;p<96;p++){
    const ys=window.map(r=>ZPCR.zpcrWellMean(r,c,Math.floor(p/12),p%12));if(!ys.every(Number.isFinite))continue;
    const xs=window.map(r=>r.cycle),xm=ZPCR.zpcrStats(xs).mean,ym=ZPCR.zpcrStats(ys).mean;
    const slope=xs.reduce((a,x,i)=>a+(x-xm)*(ys[i]-ym),0)/xs.reduce((a,x)=>a+(x-xm)**2,0);
    const rms=Math.sqrt(ys.reduce((a,y,i)=>a+(y-(ym+slope*(xs[i]-xm)))**2,0)/ys.length);
    const v=tag+' · Raw channel '+(c+1)+' · '+String.fromCharCode(65+Math.floor(p/12))+(p%12+1)+' · cycles '+lo+'–'+hi;
    put('z_early_slope',v,slope);put('z_early_residual',v,rms);
   }
  }
 }
 return out;
}
```

- [Complete exact function source](https://github.com/mihaiionitabio-alt/zpcrweb/blob/missy-public-offline-2026-10-20/documentation/releases/2026-10-31-full-wiki/code/functions/C08796.js)

```javascript
function zpcrChartContext(id){
 const def=CC_BY_ID[id.slice(3)],o=SEL_STATE.options[id]||{},decode=v=>{try{return decodeURIComponent(v||'');}catch(e){throw Error('Invalid encoded chart selector');}},insts=ccInstruments().filter(i=>i.platform==='CFX');
 const key=decode(o.instrument)|| (insts.some(i=>i.key===CC_STATE.instrument)?CC_STATE.instrument:insts[0]?.key);
 if(!key||!insts.some(i=>i.key===key))throw Error('Load ZPCR history for the requested instrument');
 const protocol=decode(o.protocol),rows=ccAllRows().filter(r=>r.instrument===key&&(!protocol||r.protocol===protocol)).sort((a,b)=>(a.date||0)-(b.date||0));
 let hours=0;rows.forEach(r=>{r.hours=hours;hours+=(r.m.run_minutes||0)/60;});
 const variants=ccVariants(def,rows),variant=decode(o.variant)||variants[0];if(!variant||!variants.includes(variant))throw Error('No data for this acquisition-step/channel variant');
 return {def,o,key,protocol,rows,variant};
}
```

 if(v.length){const ds=sets.flatMap(a=>a.slice(1).map((t,i)=>t.temps.BLOCKTEMP?.c-a[i].temps.BLOCKTEMP?.c)).filter(Number.isFinite);pattern=hi-lo<=.2?'Nearly constant block temperature · '+fmt(lo)+(hi===lo?'':'–'+fmt(hi))+' °C':ds.length&&ds.every(x=>x>=0)?'Observed heating · '+fmt(lo)+'–'+fmt(hi)+' °C':ds.length&&ds.every(x=>x<=0)?'Observed cooling · '+fmt(lo)+'–'+fmt(hi)+' °C':'Changing block temperature · '+fmt(lo)+'–'+fmt(hi)+' °C';}

```javascript
function ccI(y,cfg){
  const base=ccPhase(y,cfg.phase1),cl=mean(base),mr=base.slice(1).map((v,i)=>Math.abs(v-base[i])),
    sig=Math.max(mr.length?mean(mr)/1.128:(sd(base)||Math.abs(cl)*0.05||1),(cfg.res||0)/2)||1;
  const dead=(cfg.res||0)/2/sig,z=y.map(v=>{const q=(v-cl)/sig;return Math.abs(q)<dead?0:q;});
  return {cl,sigma:sig,pts:y.map((v,i)=>{const f=[];if(!Number.isFinite(v))return {y:v,cl,ucl:cl+3*sig,lcl:cl-3*sig,flags:f};
    if(Math.abs(z[i])>3)f.push("beyond 3σ");
    const win=(n,k,lim)=>{if(i<n-1)return false;const w=z.slice(i-n+1,i+1).filter(Number.isFinite);return Math.sign(z[i])!==0&&w.filter(q=>Math.sign(q)===Math.sign(z[i])&&Math.abs(q)>lim).length>=k;};
    if(cfg.rules.r2&&win(3,2,2))f.push("2 of 3 beyond 2σ");
    if(cfg.rules.r3&&win(5,4,1))f.push("4 of 5 beyond 1σ");
    if(cfg.rules.r4&&i>=7&&Math.sign(z[i])!==0&&z.slice(i-7,i+1).every(q=>Number.isFinite(q)&&Math.sign(q)===Math.sign(z[i])))f.push("8 on one side");
    if(cfg.rules.r5&&i>=5){const d=y.slice(i-5,i+1).map((q,j,a)=>j?Math.sign(q-a[j-1]):0).slice(1);if(d.every(s=>s===d[0]&&s!==0))f.push("6 rising/falling");}
    return {y:v,cl,ucl:cl+3*sig,lcl:cl-3*sig,flags:f};})};
}
```

```javascript
function ccCUSUM(y,cfg){
  /* Page's procedure. Two one-sided sums; each one signals when it passes h and is then
     restarted, so an excursion is reported once instead of marking every later run. The
     signal belongs to the sum that raised it (sigHi / sigLo), so the chart can colour the
     series that is actually outside and leave the other one alone. */
  const I=ccI(y,cfg),k=+cfg.k,h=+cfg.h;let hi=0,lo=0;
  return {cl:0,pts:y.map(v=>{
    let sigHi=false,sigLo=false;
    if(Number.isFinite(v)){const z=(v-I.cl)/I.sigma;
      hi=Math.max(0,hi+z-k);lo=Math.max(0,lo-z-k);
      sigHi=hi>h;sigLo=lo>h;}
    const p={y:hi,y2:-lo,raw:v,cl:0,ucl:h,lcl:-h,sigHi,sigLo,
      flags:sigHi?["upward shift (CUSUM)"]:sigLo?["downward shift (CUSUM)"]:[]};
    if(sigHi)hi=0;if(sigLo)lo=0;                 /* restart the sum that signalled */
    return p;})};
}
```

```javascript
function ccXbarS(groups,cfg){               // groups: [{mean,sd,n}]
  const ph=groups.slice(0,Math.max(Math.min(cfg.phase1,groups.length),Math.min(5,groups.length))).filter(g=>g&&Number.isFinite(g.mean));
  const X=mean(ph.map(g=>g.mean)),S=mean(ph.map(g=>g.sd).filter(Number.isFinite));
  /* three-way chart (Wheeler): the limits of the run means use the larger of the within-run spread (A3·S̄) and the
     run-to-run moving range of the means (MR̄/1.128). With many readings per run the within-run S alone gives limits
     far narrower than the normal day-to-day variation and would flag almost every run. */
  const mr=ph.slice(1).map((g,i)=>Math.abs(g.mean-ph[i].mean)),sigB=mr.length?mean(mr)/1.128:0;
  return {cl:X,sbar:S,sigB,pts:groups.map(g=>{if(!g||!Number.isFinite(g.mean))return {y:NaN,cl:X,flags:[]};
    const n=Math.max(2,g.n||2),c4=CC_C4(n),A3=3/(c4*Math.sqrt(n)),B4=1+3*Math.sqrt(1-c4*c4)/c4,w=Math.max(A3*S,3*sigB,1.5*(cfg.res||0));
    const f=[];if(Math.abs(g.mean-X)>w)f.push("mean beyond limit");if(g.sd>B4*S)f.push("spread (S) beyond limit");
    return {y:g.mean,s:g.sd,cl:X,ucl:X+w,lcl:X-w,sUcl:B4*S,flags:f};})};
}
```

```javascript
function ccThermalSteps(t,y,setpoints,band=0.5,minHold=3){
  if(!t||t.length<10)return [];
  if(!setpoints||!setpoints.length){           // no protocol: find the plateaus the log itself shows
    const bins=new Map();
    for(let k=1;k<y.length;k++)if(Math.abs(y[k]-y[k-1])<0.15*(t[k]-t[k-1]||1)){const b=Math.round(y[k]);bins.set(b,(bins.get(b)||0)+1);}
    setpoints=[...bins].filter(([,c])=>c>=20).map(([b])=>b);
  }
  const plateaus=[];let cur=null;
  for(let k=0;k<y.length;k++){
    const sp=setpoints.find(s=>Math.abs(y[k]-s)<=band);
    if(cur&&sp===cur.sp){cur.end=k;continue;}
    if(cur&&t[cur.end]-t[cur.start]>=minHold)plateaus.push(cur);
    cur=sp===undefined?null:{sp,start:k,end:k};
  }
  if(cur&&t[cur.end]-t[cur.start]>=minHold)plateaus.push(cur);
  const out=[];
  for(let p=1;p<plateaus.length;p++){
    const A=plateaus[p-1],B=plateaus[p];if(A.sp===B.sp)continue;
    const up=B.sp>A.sp,x10=A.sp+0.1*(B.sp-A.sp),x90=A.sp+0.9*(B.sp-A.sp);
    let k10=null,k90=null,ext=up?-Infinity:Infinity;
    for(let k=A.end;k<=B.start;k++){
      if(k10===null&&(up?y[k]>=x10:y[k]<=x10))k10=k;
      if(k90===null&&(up?y[k]>=x90:y[k]<=x90))k90=k;
      if(k90!==null)ext=up?Math.max(ext,y[k]):Math.min(ext,y[k]);
    }
    if(k10===null||k90===null||t[k90]===t[k10])continue;
    const hold=y.slice(B.start,B.end+1),m=mean(hold);
    out.push({from:A.sp,to:B.sp,up,rate:Math.abs((y[k90]-y[k10])/(t[k90]-t[k10])),
      overshoot:Number.isFinite(ext)?Math.max(0,up?ext-B.sp:B.sp-ext):0,settling:t[B.start]-t[k90],
      offset:m-B.sp,sd:sd(hold)||0});
  }
  return out;
}
```

```javascript
function ccTransitionPairs(run){
  const progs=((run.protocol||{}).programs||[]).filter(p=>(p.segments||[]).length),R=v=>Math.round(Number(v)*10)/10;
  const out=new Map(),add=(a,b)=>{if(!Number.isFinite(+a.target)||!Number.isFinite(+b.target))return;
    const A=R(a.target),B=R(b.target);if(Math.abs(A-B)<2)return;
    const sl=Number(b.slope);if(/cont/i.test(b.acqMode||"")||(Number.isFinite(sl)&&sl>0&&sl<1))return;
    out.set(`${A}→${B}`,{from:A,to:B});};
  progs.forEach((p,pi)=>{const s=p.segments;
    for(let i=0;i+1<s.length;i++)add(s[i],s[i+1]);
    if((+p.cycles||1)>1&&s.length>1)add(s[s.length-1],s[0]);
    if(pi>0){const q=progs[pi-1].segments;add(q[q.length-1],s[0]);}});
  return [...out.values()];
}
```

```javascript
function ccTransitions(t,y,pairs,band=0.5){
  if(!t||t.length<10||!pairs.length)return null;
  /* edge crossings are interpolated between log samples: at 4.4 °C/s the LightCycler moves ≈ 1.8 °C between two
     samples, more than the ±0.5 °C band, so a sample-by-sample test would miss short passes through a target */
  const exp=new Set(pairs.map(p=>`${p.from}→${p.to}`)),targets=uniq(pairs.flatMap(p=>[p.from,p.to]));
  const inB=(v,s)=>Math.abs(v-s)<=band,at=(k,level)=>t[k-1]+(t[k]-t[k-1])*((level-y[k-1])/((y[k]-y[k-1])||1e-9));
  const got={};let prev=null,leave=NaN,cand=null;
  for(let k=0;k<y.length;k++){
    if(prev===null){const s0=targets.find(s=>inB(y[k],s));if(s0!==undefined){prev=s0;leave=t[k];}continue;}
    /* a hold at a temperature that is not the next programmed step (start of the run, pre-heat, manual pause):
       after 2 s in its band it becomes the new starting point, without recording a transition */
    if(cand){if(!inB(y[k],cand.s))cand=null;else if(t[k]-cand.since>=2){prev=cand.s;leave=t[k];cand=null;continue;}}
    if(inB(y[k],prev)){leave=t[k];}
    else if(k>0&&inB(y[k-1],prev)){leave=at(k,y[k]>prev?prev+band:prev-band);}    // left the band between two samples
    if(k===0)continue;
    const lo=Math.min(y[k-1],y[k]),hi=Math.max(y[k-1],y[k]);
    for(const s of targets){
      if(s===prev||inB(y[k-1],s)||hi<s-band||lo>s+band)continue;          // this segment enters the band of s
      const key=`${prev}→${s}`;if(!exp.has(key)){if(!cand||cand.s!==s)cand={s,since:t[k]};continue;}   // passing through, not a programmed step
      const edge=y[k-1]<s?s-band:s+band,tin=at(k,edge);
      if(Number.isFinite(leave)&&tin>leave)(got[key]=got[key]||[]).push(tin-leave);
      prev=s;leave=inB(y[k],s)?t[k]:tin;break;
    }
  }
  const o={};for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(got))if(v.length)o[k+" °C"]=ccMedian(v);
  return Object.keys(o).length?o:null;
}
```

```javascript
function ccThin(t,y,slices){
  if(t.length<=2*slices)return {seconds:t.slice(),temp:y.slice()};
  const per=t.length/slices,ts=[],ys=[];
  for(let k=0;k<slices;k++){const a=Math.floor(k*per),b=Math.min(t.length,Math.floor((k+1)*per));let lo=a,hi=a;
    for(let i=a;i<b;i++){if(y[i]<y[lo])lo=i;if(y[i]>y[hi])hi=i;}
    for(const i of lo<hi?[lo,hi]:lo>hi?[hi,lo]:[lo]){ts.push(t[i]);ys.push(y[i]);}}
  return {seconds:ts,temp:ys};
}
```

```javascript
function ccPeakRates(t,y,win=2,min=1){
  const up=[],dn=[];let j=0,cur=null;
  for(let i=0;i<t.length;i++){
    while(t[i]-t[j]>win)j++;
    const s=i>j?(y[i]-y[j])/(t[i]-t[j]):0,d=s>min?1:s<-min?-1:0;
    if(d&&(!cur||cur.d!==d)){if(cur)(cur.d>0?up:dn).push(cur.m);cur={d,m:Math.abs(s)};}
    else if(d)cur.m=Math.max(cur.m,Math.abs(s));
    else if(cur){(cur.d>0?up:dn).push(cur.m);cur=null;}
  }
  if(cur)(cur.d>0?up:dn).push(cur.m);
  const med=a=>{const v=a.slice().sort((p,q)=>p-q);return v.length?v[Math.floor(v.length/2)]:NaN;};
  return {heat:med(up),cool:med(dn),nUp:up.length,nDown:dn.length};
}
```

function effWol(curve){
  if(!curve||curve.length<8)return null;
  const F=curve.map(Number),n=F.length,cyc=[...Array(n)].map((_,i)=>i+1),fmin=Math.min(...F),fmax=Math.max(...F);
  if(fmax-fmin<50)return null;
  let best=null;const lo=fmin-0.02*(fmax-fmin),hi=fmin*0.999;
  for(let k=0;k<12;k++){
    const baseline=lo+(hi-lo)*k/11,y=F.map(v=>v-baseline);if(y.some(v=>v<=0))continue;
    const ly=y.map(Math.log10),amp=Math.max(...y),idx=[];
    for(let i=0;i<y.length;i++)if(y[i]>=0.02*amp&&y[i]<=0.25*amp)idx.push(i);
    if(idx.length<4)continue;
    const runs=[[idx[0]]];for(let i=1;i<idx.length;i++){if(idx[i]===idx[i-1]+1)runs.at(-1).push(idx[i]);else runs.push([idx[i]]);}
    const run=runs.reduce((a,c)=>c.length>a.length?c:a);if(run.length<4)continue;
    const f=fitLin(run.map(i=>cyc[i]),run.map(i=>ly[i]));
    if(f.slope<=0)continue;if(!best||f.r2>best.r2)best={...f,baseline,window:[run[0]+1,run.at(-1)+1]};
  }
  if(!best||best.r2<0.98)return null;
  const E=(10**best.slope-1)*100;
  return E>30&&E<140?Math.round(E*10)/10:null;
}

```javascript
function dyeChemistryOf(run){
  /* SYBR Green and other intercalators must not be reported as probes: the
     chemistry changes how LinRegPCR treats the amplification plateau. */
  const names=(run.protocol.channels||[]).map(c=>(c.name||"").toLowerCase()).join(" ");
  const anaNames=run.analyses.map(a=>(a.name||"").toLowerCase()).join(" ");
  const text=names+" "+anaNames+" "+(run.meta.name||"").toLowerCase();
  if(/sybr|syto|eva\s*green|intercalat/.test(text))return "DNA-binding dye";
  if(/hybprobe|fret/.test(text))return "hybridization probe";
  return "hydrolysis probe";
}
```

function makeRDMLXML(run){
  const chemistry=dyeChemistryOf(run);
  const results=[...(run.wells||[]).filter(w=>w.curve),...(run.tmWells||[]).filter(w=>w.meltCurve&&w.meltCurve.length)];
  const targets=uniq(results.map(w=>w.target||"target"));
  const samples=uniq(results.map(w=>w.sample||w.well));
  const roleOf={};results.forEach(w=>{roleOf[w.sample||w.well]=w.role;});
  const dyeOf=t=>rdmlId("dye",t);
  let x=`<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n<rdml version="1.4" xmlns="http://www.rdml.org">\n`;
  x+=`<dateMade>${new Date().toISOString().replace(/\.\d+Z$/,"Z")}</dateMade>\n`;
  x+=`<id><publisher>ixo-qc-export</publisher><serialNumber>${xesc(sourceUidOf(run)||run.meta.name||run.file)}</serialNumber></id>\n`;
  x+=`<experimenter id="op"><firstName>${xesc(operatorOf(run)||"operator")}</firstName><lastName>-</lastName></experimenter>\n`;
  /* dyes first: the element order in RDML 1.4 is dye, sample, target, experiment */
  targets.forEach(t=>{

    x+=`<target id="${xesc(rdmlId("tgt",t))}" type="toi"><dyeId id="${xesc(dyeOf(t))}"/></target>\n`;
  });

  analysisGroups(results).forEach(group=>{
    x+=`<run id="${xesc(rdmlId("run",(run.meta.name||run.file)+"_"+group.key))}">\n`;
    x+=`<instrument>${xesc(run.meta.InstrumentName||"LightCycler 480")}</instrument>\n`;
    x+=`<pcrFormat><rows>${run.rows}</rows><columns>${run.cols}</columns>`
      +`<rowLabel>ABC</rowLabel><columnLabel>123</columnLabel></pcrFormat>\n`;
    group.wells.forEach(w=>{
      x+=`<react id="${w.pos+1}"><sample id="${xesc(rdmlId("smp",w.sample||w.well))}"/>`;
      x+=`<data><tar id="${xesc(rdmlId("tgt",w.target||"target"))}"/>`;
      if(Number.isFinite(w.CpRaw)&&w.CpRaw>0)x+=`<cq>${w.CpRaw}</cq>`;
      if(w.tms&&Number.isFinite(w.tms[0]))x+=`<meltTemp>${w.tms[0]}</meltTemp>`;
      if(w.curve)w.curve.forEach((v,i)=>{x+=`<adp><cyc>${i+1}</cyc><fluor>${v}</fluor></adp>`;});
      if(w.meltCurve)w.meltCurve.forEach(p=>{

      });
      x+=`</data></react>\n`;
    });
    x+=`</run>\n`;
  });
  x+=`</experiment>\n</rdml>\n`;

```javascript
function makeQpcrWide(run,analysisKey){
  const groups=curveAnalysisGroups(run);
  const group=analysisKey==null?groups[0]:groups.find(g=>g.key===analysisKey);
  const wells=group?group.wells:[];
  if(!wells.length)return "";
  const n=Math.max(...wells.map(w=>w.curve.length));
  const names=wells.map(w=>`${safeName(w.target||"tgt")}_${safeName(w.sample||w.well)}_${w.well}`);
  const lines=["Cycles,"+names.join(",")];
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    lines.push([i+1,...wells.map(w=>i<w.curve.length?w.curve[i]:"")].join(","));
  }
  return lines.join("\n")+"\n";
}
```

function makeRDES(run,analysisKey){
  const groups=curveAnalysisGroups(run);
  const group=analysisKey==null?groups[0]:groups.find(g=>g.key===analysisKey);
  const head=["source_uid","source_crc32","experiment","well","sample","target","analysis","channel","filter","role","instrument_type",

  const lines=[head.join("\t")];
  (group?group.wells:[]).forEach(w=>{

      w.CpRaw??"",w.call,i+1,v].join("\t")));
  });
  return lines.join("\n")+"\n";
}

```javascript
function rScript(){
  return `# qpcR — fit the LightCycler 480 curves and compare with the stored Cq.
#
# Input : <run>_qpcR_curves.csv  (wide; column 1 is "Cycles", one column per well)
#         <run>_cq_values.csv    (the Cq the instrument stored)
#
# install.packages("qpcR")
library(qpcR)

wide <- read.csv("REPLACE_WIDE", check.names = FALSE)
stopifnot(names(wide)[1] == "Cycles")   # pcrbatch() requires this exact name

# Fit every well with the default four-parameter log-logistic model.
ml <- modlist(wide, cyc = 1, fluo = 2:ncol(wide), baseline = "lin")

# Per-well efficiency and second-derivative-maximum Cq.
res <- pcrbatch(wide, cyc = 1, fluo = 2:ncol(wide), model = l4,
                methods = c("sigfit", "sliwin"), plot = FALSE)
write.csv(res, "qpcR_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Compare qpcR's cpD2 with the Cq the instrument stored.
stored <- read.csv("REPLACE_CQ")
qcp <- data.frame(
  column = colnames(wide)[-1],
  cpD2   = sapply(ml, function(m) tryCatch(efficiency(m, plot = FALSE)$cpD2,
                                           error = function(e) NA_real_))
)
qcp$well <- sub("^.*_", "", qcp$column)
cmp <- merge(qcp, stored[, c("well", "cq")], by = "well")
cmp$difference <- cmp$cpD2 - cmp$cq
print(summary(cmp$difference))
write.csv(cmp, "qpcR_vs_stored_cq.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# A disagreement of a few tenths of a cycle is normal: qpcR fits a sigmoid to
# the raw curve while the instrument used its own baseline and threshold.
# A disagreement of several cycles means the curves and the Cq values did not
# come from the same channel, which is worth investigating before going further.
`;
}
```

function pyScript(){
  return `# rdmlpython / LinRegPCR — reanalyse the exported curves.
#
# Input : <run>.rdml   (RDML 1.4, written by this page)
#
# pip install lxml numpy scipy
# git clone --recursive https://github.com/RDML-consortium/rdmlpython.git
#
# The --recursive matters: the XSD schemas live in a submodule, and validate()
# raises OSError without them. LinRegPCR itself runs without the schemas.

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "rdmlpython")     # adjust to your checkout
import rdml

doc = rdml.Rdml("REPLACE_RDML")
print("RDML version:", doc.version())   # expect 1.4 — LinRegPCR refuses anything older

for exp in doc.experiments():
    for run in exp.runs():
        result = run.linRegPCR(
            updateRDML=True,          # write efficiencies and N0 back into the document
            saveResultsCSV=True,
            pcrEfficiencyExl=0.05,    # exclude wells more than 5% off the group efficiency
            verbose=False,
        )
        csv = result.get("resultsCSV", "")
        with open("linregpcr_results.tsv", "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            fh.write(csv)
        print("wells analysed:", max(0, len(csv.splitlines()) - 1))

doc.save("reanalysed.rdml")

# The columns to read first are "indiv PCR eff" (per-well efficiency) and
# "N0 (mean eff)" (starting concentration). Wells LinRegPCR excluded carry a
# reason in the "excluded" column — that column is the useful QC output here,
# because it flags curves the instrument accepted and LinRegPCR did not.
`;
}

 else if((m=s.match(/^(.+) · group (\d+) · P ([a-f0-9]{12}) · (.+)$/)))out=m[1]+' · 采集组 '+m[2]+' · P '+m[3]+' · '+zhPhrase(m[4]);

 else if((m=s.match(/^(\d+) statistics rows across (\d+) separate cohorts\. Targets, protocols, instrument identities, channels, acquisition groups and roles stay separate\. Full cohort identities are included in the report\.$/)))out=m[2]+' 个独立分组，共 '+m[1]+' 行统计。靶标、实验程序、仪器身份、通道、采集组和样本角色分别统计。报告保留完整分组信息。';

```javascript
function maraInput(run,p=SOP,evidence=maraEvidence(run)){
 const exportContext=SS_EXPORT_CONTEXT.get(run);
 const rapid=p.method.standard_number===17;
 const refName=p.method.reference_genes?.[0]?.target||'';
 const refSpec=p.targets.find(t=>t.kind==='reference'&&t.match&&sopMatcher(t.match)(refName));
 const reference=refName;
 const selected=rapid?(p.method.selected_assays||[]):[p.method.selected_event].filter(Boolean);
 const specs=selected.map(name=>({name,spec:p.targets.find(t=>t.kind==='target'&&(t.match===name||sopMatcher(t.match)(name)))}));
 const matchAssay=w=>{const t=String(w.target||w.analysis||'');if(refName&&(t.toLowerCase()===refName.toLowerCase()||refSpec&&sopMatcher(refSpec.match)(t)))return reference;return specs.find(x=>x.name===t||x.spec&&sopMatcher(x.spec.match)(t))?.name||'';};
 const all=ssWells(run),records=[];
 for(const [i,shown] of all.entries()){
  const w=exportContext?.rows.get(shown)||shown;
  const assay=matchAssay(w);if(!assay)continue;
  const id=maraWellID(w,i),e=evidence.reactions[id]||{};
  const matched=p.controls.filter(c=>c.id!=='cal-lowest'&&maraControlMatches(c,w,p));
  const kinds=new Set(matched.map(c=>/pos-quant/.test(c.id)?'quantitative':/pos-qual/.test(c.id)?'positive':/blank/.test(c.id)?'blank':/^neg/.test(c.id)?'negative':'unknown'));
  let role=kinds.size===1?[...kinds][0]:kinds.size>1?'ambiguous':'sample';
  if(e.kind==='calibrator'||role==='sample'&&(w.role==='Standard'||w.instrRole==='Standard'))role='calibrator';
  let sampleGroup=w.sample||'',subsample='',mappingError=false;
  if(role==='sample'&&!rapid){
   try{const pattern=p.sample_id?.pattern,re=pattern?new RegExp(pattern,(p.sample_id.flags||'i').replace(/[gy]/g,'')):null,m=re?.exec(String(w.sample||''));
    if(!m?.groups?.sample||!m.groups.subsample)mappingError=true;else{sampleGroup=m.groups.sample;subsample=m.groups.subsample;}
   }catch{mappingError=true;}
  }
  records.push({id,physicalId:JSON.stringify([w.pos??w.well??i,assay]),source:shown,originalSource:w,assay,role,sample:String(w.sample||''),sampleGroup,subsample,mappingError,cq:sopCq(w),curve:e.curve||'unknown',copies:e.copies,level:e.level||'',pair:e.pair||'',omitted:sopOmitted(w)});
 }
 return {records,context:{...evidence.context,reference,assays:selected,selectionPending:SAMPLE_SELECTION.pending,complete:!run.isTemplate&&(!run.eds||run.eds.exp?.runState==='COMPLETE')}};
}
```

````javascript
function maraStandardsIndex(){
 const lines=['# MARA 1012 — JSON profiles and method references','','32 JSON profiles: 2 screening, 15 identification, 15 quantification.','','Calculations are provisional until laboratory approval. Enter actual control assignments; no commercial CRM identity or percentage is invented. The LOD is not the positive-control percentage.','','## Method specifications','','- Identification, standards 1–15: section 5. Controls: 5.4.5 / 5.4.7; three independent subsamples × one PCR each (5.4.6.1); majority interpretation (5.5); conditional relative comparison (5.5.2). Positive control: the named event at an actual content within 0.1–1.0% (5.4.5.3).','- Quantification, standards 1–15: section 6. Three subsamples × at least three PCR each (6.4.7.1); matched CRM curves (6.4.6–6.4.8); ratio of mean copies (6.4.9); separate QC/sample acceptance (6.4.10); per-event uncertainty (6.4.11); reporting (6.5); LOD/LOQ (6.6–6.7). Quantitative control: the named event at its actual assigned/certified percentage, comparable to the declared threshold.','- Threshold screening, standard 16: control/uncertainty coverage (3.1); ≥3 subsamples × three PCR each (5.3.6.1); controls (5.3.7); two-stage ΔCt/ΔΔCt (5.3.8); decisions and inclusive ±0.4 band (5.4). No numerical percentage or calibration curves.','- Presence screening, standard 17: controls (7.3.4–7.3.5); sample calls (8.1); LOD 1% (10). No fixed positive-control percentage is specified. Record the actual event/target-containing material and assigned percentage when applicable. Plasmids have no genomic mass fraction by default.','','## Profiles',''];
 for(const role of ['screening','identification','quantification']){
  lines.push('### '+role,'','| SOP / standard | Event / scope | Reference | JSON | Control declaration |','|---|---|---|---|---|');
  for(const x of MARA_PROFILE_LIBRARY.filter(x=>x.role===role)){
   const p=x.profile,event=x.event||(x.standard===16?'Selected published event assay':'Selected Annex A/B panel'),ref=p.method.reference_genes?.map(r=>r.target).join(', ')||'Declare matching crop reference';
   const control=role==='identification'?event+' — actual control 0.1–1.0%':role==='quantification'?event+' — X% (assigned/certified)':x.standard===16?'Selected event — X%, threshold and uncertainty':'Actual event/target control; no fixed % specified';
   lines.push('| '+p.name+' | '+event+' | '+ref+' | ['+x.key+'.json]('+x.key+'.json) | '+control+' |');
  }lines.push('');
 }
 lines.push('## Differences and unresolved inputs','','- GGK2: Sad1 reference; resolve the 50 ng reaction / 100 ng LOD–LOQ basis discrepancy.','- KJC017: 22/44-copy LOD/LOQ; other event standards use 20/40 copies.','- KJ1003: confirm the documented 19-bp junction sequence.','- Uncertainty constants, DNA inputs and CRM maxima are standard-specific.','- Exact-LOQ reporting requires a laboratory policy; default: hold for review.','- Uncertainty mode: standard (default) or validated laboratory total model. Laboratory coefficients replace the standard budget; no complete uncertainties are automatically added together. Laboratory scope, range, components and coverage factor must be confirmed. JRC MU guidance 3rd edition, sections 2.3–2.5, explains precision/bias combination within one budget.','- Sample-name regex must capture sample and subsample identities. Record explicit curve evidence, CRM copy assignments and quantitative-QC reaction pairing.','- Standards 18–20 concern bioinformatics/sequencing and are outside these qPCR profiles.','','## Source files','','Each JSON records source clauses and the PDF checksum. Sources: D:/IXO/CHINESE/gmo/.');
 for(const n of [...new Set(MARA_PROFILE_LIBRARY.map(x=>x.standard))].sort((a,b)=>a-b)){const p=MARA_PROFILE_LIBRARY.find(x=>x.standard===n).profile;lines.push('- '+p.name+': '+p.method.sources[0].pdf);}
 lines.push('','Supporting explanation: A standard-curve-free ΔΔCt method for rapid GMO compliance screening relative to labeling thresholds, doi:10.3389/fpls.2026.1918379, sections 2.2 and 3.3. Research examples do not replace normative MARA requirements.','',
 '## Reproducing the embedded profile SHA-256','',
 'Hash the delivered JSON object directly, without applying defaults or normalisation. Remove only the top-level sha256 and locked properties. Recursively sort object keys using JavaScript Object.keys(value).sort(); preserve array order and all values. Serialize with JSON.stringify (no indentation, no trailing newline). Hash its UTF-8 bytes, without BOM, using SHA-256; output lowercase hexadecimal. This is the application sopCanonical/sopHash algorithm, not RFC 8785. The locked flag is deliberately excluded so that locking does not change the scientific profile identity. No nested fields are removed. SHA256SUMS.txt instead hashes the exact file bytes, including formatting and final newline.','',
 'Independent Node.js reproduction (save as verify-profile.cjs; run node verify-profile.cjs profile.json):','',
 '```js',
 "const fs = require('node:fs'), crypto = require('node:crypto');",
 "const p = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8').replace(/^\\uFEFF/, ''));",
 'const expected = p.sha256; delete p.sha256; delete p.locked;',
 "const sort = v => Array.isArray(v) ? v.map(sort) : v && typeof v === 'object' ? Object.keys(v).sort().reduce((o,k) => (o[k]=sort(v[k]),o),{}) : v;",
 "const actual = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(sort(p)), 'utf8').digest('hex');",
 "console.log(actual); if (actual !== expected) process.exitCode = 1;",
 '```','');return lines.join('\n');
}
````

```javascript
function maraRuleRows(p=SOP){
 const source=p.method?.sources?.[0]||{},perf=p.performance||{},sub=p.replicates?.subsamples||{};
 const rows=[['Method role',ui(maraRoleLabel(p))],['Method',p.analyticalRole==='identification'?'1':p.analyticalRole==='quantification'?'2':p.method?.standard_number===16?'ΔΔCt':ui('Rapid PCR')],['Event',p.method?.selected_event||ui('Not declared')],['Reference assay',(p.method?.reference_genes||[]).map(x=>x.target).join(', ')||ui('Not declared')],['Ct cut-off',perf.ct_cutoff??36]];
 for(const [key,label] of [['lod_percent','LOD (%)'],['loq_percent','LOQ (%)'],['lod_copies','LOD (copies)'],['loq_copies','LOQ (copies)']])if(perf[key]!=null)rows.push([label,perf[key]]);
 for(const [key,label] of [['lod_basis_template_ng_per_reaction','LOD DNA basis (ng)'],['loq_basis_template_ng_per_reaction','LOQ DNA basis (ng)']])if(perf[key])rows.push([label,perf[key]]);
 if(perf.template_ng_per_reaction)rows.push(['Sample DNA (ng/reaction)',perf.template_ng_per_reaction]);
 if(p.calibrator?.maximum_template_ng_per_reaction)rows.push(['CRM maximum DNA (ng/reaction)',p.calibrator.maximum_template_ng_per_reaction]);

 if(sub.count)rows.push(['Subsamples',sub.count],['PCR amplifications per subsample',p.analyticalRole==='quantification'?ui('At least 3'):sub.amplifications_per_subsample]);
 if(p.replicates?.control_amplifications)rows.push(['Controls: PCR amplifications',ui('At least 3')]);
 if(p.analyticalRole==='quantification'){
  const u=p.calculation?.uncertainty||{};rows.push(['u₀',u.u0],['uᵣ',u.ur],['k',u.coverage_factor_k],['u','√(u₀² + (uᵣ × mean)²)'],['U','k × u'],['c_k','mean(c_event,k) / mean(c_reference,k) × 100'],['f',1.693],['Below LOQ: detected, not quantified','']);
  for(const label of ['Standard curve: R² ≥ 0.98; slope −3.6 to −3.1; ≥5 levels','CRM: |bias| < 2 × u_bias','Laboratory control: sR ≤ 25% and |biasR| ≤ 25%','Sample: s′R ≤ 25% only at or above LOQ'])rows.push([label,'']);
 }else if(p.method?.standard_number!==17){rows.push(['ΔCt','mean(Ct_event) − mean(Ct_reference)'],['ΔΔCt','mean(ΔCt_sample) − mean(ΔCt_control)'],['ddCt < −0.4: higher; ddCt > +0.4: lower',''],['At |ddCt| ≤ 0.4, use full quantification','']);}
 else {rows.push(['Screening is limited to the tested panel at its stated LOD','']);for(const assay of p.method?.rapid_event_assay_catalogue||[])rows.push(['Annex B assay catalogue',assay.target]);}
 return rows.map(([rule,value])=>({rule:ui(rule),value:String(value??'')}));
}
```

```javascript
function pseudonymMap(){
  if(PSEUDO_MAP)return PSEUDO_MAP;
  const m=new Map();let k=0;
  RUNS.forEach(r=>(r.wells||[]).concat(r.tmWells||[]).forEach(w=>{
    const s=w.sample||"";if(!s||m.has(s))return;
    m.set(s,roleFromName(s)!=="Unknown"?s:`S${String(++k).padStart(2,"0")}`);
  }));
  RUNS.forEach(r=>Object.values(r.plate||{}).forEach(x=>{const s=x.name;if(s&&!m.has(s))m.set(s,roleFromName(s)!=="Unknown"?s:`S${String(++k).padStart(2,"0")}`);}));
  return PSEUDO_MAP=m;
}
```

function zipMemberNames(bytes){
 const v=new DataView(bytes.buffer,bytes.byteOffset,bytes.byteLength);let e=-1;
 for(let i=bytes.length-22;i>=Math.max(0,bytes.length-65557);i--)if(v.getUint32(i,true)===0x06054b50){e=i;break;}
 if(e<0)throw Error('ZIP central directory missing');
 const count=v.getUint16(e+10,true),size=v.getUint32(e+12,true);let at=v.getUint32(e+16,true);
 if(v.getUint16(e+4,true)||v.getUint16(e+6,true)||count>10000||at+size>e)throw Error('ZIP limits/directory invalid');
 const names=[];for(let i=0;i<count;i++){if(at+46>e||v.getUint32(at,true)!==0x02014b50)throw Error('ZIP directory bounds');const nl=v.getUint16(at+28,true),el=v.getUint16(at+30,true),cl=v.getUint16(at+32,true);if(at+46+nl+el+cl>e)throw Error('ZIP filename bounds');names.push(new TextDecoder().decode(bytes.subarray(at+46,at+46+nl)));at+=46+nl+el+cl;}return names;
}

```javascript
function validatePublicRun(run,source){
 validateRunBoundary(run,source.name);
 const fail=m=>{throw Error(source.name+': run model: '+m);},object=v=>v!==null&&typeof v==='object'&&!Array.isArray(v)&&!ArrayBuffer.isView(v);
 if(Array.isArray(run))fail('run must be an object');
 for(const field of ['meta','plate','allCurves','format','integrity','protocol'])if(run[field]!=null&&!object(run[field]))fail(field+' must be an object');
 for(const field of ['wells','tmWells','genoResults','rqResults','otherResults'])if(run[field]!=null){const a=run[field];if(!Array.isArray(a)||a.length>APP_LIMITS.maxWellsPerRun||a.some(x=>!object(x)))fail(field+' must contain bounded result objects');}
 const rows=run.rows,cols=run.cols;
 if(rows!=null&&(!Number.isInteger(rows)||rows<0||rows>100))fail('invalid plate rows');
 if(cols!=null&&(!Number.isInteger(cols)||cols<0||cols>100))fail('invalid plate columns');
 if(!!rows!==!!cols)fail('incomplete plate geometry');
 const size=rows*cols;
 for(const field of ['wells','tmWells','genoResults','rqResults','otherResults'])for(const result of run[field]||[])for(const field of ['pos','position'])if(result[field]!=null&&(!Number.isInteger(result[field])||result[field]<0||(size&&result[field]>=size)))fail('result position out of range');
 if(size>APP_LIMITS.maxWellsPerRun)fail('plate exceeds position limit');
 if(size&&run.plate)for(const pos of Object.keys(run.plate))if(!/^\d+$/.test(pos)||+pos>=size||!object(run.plate[pos]))fail('invalid plate position '+pos);
 if(run.meta?.sourceSHA256!=null&&!/^[a-f\d]{64}$/i.test(run.meta.sourceSHA256))fail('invalid source SHA-256');
 if(run.meta?.sourceBytes!=null&&run.meta.sourceBytes!==source.bytes.length)fail('source byte count disagrees');
 if(run.pcrd&&run.zpcr)fail('conflicting raw payload types');
 if(run.pcrdLocked){if(run.pcrd||run.zpcr||run.wells.length||run.tmWells?.length||Object.keys(run.allCurves||{}).length||size)fail('encrypted inventory contains decoded measurements');}
 const raw=run.pcrd||run.zpcr;
 if(raw){
  if(!object(raw)||!Array.isArray(raw.reads)||!raw.reads.length||raw.reads.length>100000)fail('invalid raw read collection');
  const g=raw.grid;if(!object(g)||g.sampleRows!==rows||g.cols!==cols||!Number.isInteger(g.referenceRows)||g.referenceRows<0||g.referenceRows>10)fail('sample/reference geometry disagrees');
  const first=raw.reads[0];
  for(const [i,r]of raw.reads.entries()){
   if(!object(r)||r.rows!==rows+g.referenceRows||r.cols!==cols||!Number.isInteger(r.channels)||r.channels<1||r.channels>32||r.channels!==first.channels)fail('read '+i+' geometry disagrees');
   const width=run.pcrd?r.tupleWidth:4;
   if(!Number.isInteger(width)||width<1||width>4)fail('read tuple width');
   const numeric=a=>(Array.isArray(a)||ArrayBuffer.isView(a))&&typeof a.length==='number';
   if(!numeric(r.wellData)||r.wellData.length!==r.rows*r.cols*r.channels*4)fail('read '+i+' payload length disagrees');
   if(r.darkData!=null&&(!numeric(r.darkData)||r.darkData.length!==r.channels*4))fail('read '+i+' dark payload length disagrees');
   if(run.pcrd&&(!numeric(r.originalData)||r.originalData.length!==r.rows*r.cols*r.channels*width||!numeric(r.originalDark)||r.originalDark.length!==r.channels*width))fail('read '+i+' original tuple length disagrees');
   if(Array.from(r.wellData).some(n=>typeof n!=='number')||(r.darkData&&Array.from(r.darkData).some(n=>typeof n!=='number')))fail('non-numeric raw payload');
   if(!Number.isInteger(r.step)||!Number.isInteger(r.cycle))fail('read '+i+' acquisition identity invalid');
  }
  if(raw.layout!=null&&(!Array.isArray(raw.layout)||raw.layout.some(x=>!object(x)||!Number.isInteger(x.position)||x.position<0||x.position>=size)))fail('invalid sample layout');
 }
 return run;
}

No new reader self-test, checksum scan or hardware diagnostic was run.  if(!RUNS.length)return pair('No experiment run views are loaded.','尚未加载实验运行视图。');
 if(key==='instruments'||key==='cohort'){const known=RUNS.filter(r=>{const m=r.meta||{};return m.InstrumentID||m.SerialNumber||m.InstrumentName;}),ids=[...new Set(known.map(ccInstrumentKey))],protocols=[...new Set(RUNS.map(ccProtocolKey).filter(x=>x!=='(protocol not decoded)'))],missing=RUNS.length-known.length,missingProtocol=RUNS.filter(r=>ccProtocolKey(r)==='(protocol not decoded)').length;if(key==='instruments')return page(ids.length+' distinct recorded platform/instrument labels; '+missing+' run views have no recorded instrument identifier. Labels are not independently verified device identities.','不同的已记录平台／仪器标签 '+ids.length+' 个；'+missing+' 个运行视图没有仪器标识。标签不代表经过独立验证的设备身份。',ids);return pair(ids.length+' distinct recorded platform/instrument labels; '+protocols.length+' decoded protocol signatures; '+missing+' run views lack an instrument identifier and '+missingProtocol+' lack a decoded protocol. '+(ids.length>1||protocols.length>1?'The loaded records include different cohorts. ':'Matching labels and protocol signatures alone do not establish comparability. ')+'Select one instrument, protocol and acquisition context before comparing control charts.','不同的已记录平台／仪器标签 '+ids.length+' 个；已解码方案签名 '+protocols.length+' 个；缺少仪器标识 '+missing+' 个，缺少已解码方案 '+missingProtocol+' 个。'+(ids.length>1||protocols.length>1?'已加载记录包含不同数据组。':'仅标签及方案签名相同并不能确定可比性。')+'比较控制图前请选择单一仪器、方案及采集条件。');}
 if(key==='targets'){const values=[...new Set(RUNS.flatMap(r=>(r.wells||[]).map(w=>w.target).filter(v=>typeof v==='string'&&v.trim())))];return page(values.length+' distinct recorded target labels across all loaded stored result rows. This does not count uncollected channels.','所有已加载存储结果行中有 '+values.length+' 个不同靶标标签。这不统计未采集通道。',values);}
 if(key==='standards'){const all=RUNS.flatMap(r=>ssWells(r)),n=all.filter(w=>w.role==='Standard').length;return pair(n+' included stored result rows have the exact Standard role, across '+RUNS.length+' run views.  if(key==='newest'||key==='oldest'){const dated=RUNS.map((run,ri)=>{const t=runTimes(run);return {run,ri,time:Number.isFinite(t.start)?t.start:t.created,basis:Number.isFinite(t.start)?'recorded run start':'recorded experiment creation'};}).filter(x=>Number.isFinite(x.time));if(!dated.length)return pair('No readable run start or experiment creation timestamps.','没有可读的运行开始或实验创建时间戳。');const extreme=(key==='newest'?Math.max:Math.min)(...dated.map(x=>x.time)),hits=dated.filter(x=>x.time===extreme);return page((key==='newest'?'Newest':'Oldest')+' available timestamp; '+(RUNS.length-dated.length)+' run views have no usable timestamp.  if(key.startsWith('duration:')){const n=Number(key.slice(9)),run=RUNS[n-1];if(!run)return pair('Requested run is not loaded.','所选运行未加载。');const t=runTimes(run);return Number.isFinite(t.durationMin)&&t.durationMin>=0?pair('Run '+n+'; '+runName(run)+'. This is not file-reading time.','第 '+n+' 次运行；'+runName(run)+'。记录的开始至结束时长 '+t.durationMin.toFixed(1)+' 分钟。这不是文件读取时间。'):pair('Run '+n+' has no usable recorded start-to-end duration.','第 '+n+' 次运行没有可用的已记录开始至结束时长。');}

 if(key==='origin'){const pick=selected();if(!pick)return pair('Select a single-run graph first; the current view does not identify one source run.','请先选择单次运行图表；当前页面没有确定单一源运行。');const r=pick.run,m=r.meta||{};return pair('Run '+(pick.ri+1)+'; source filename '+text(r.file)+'; instrument label '+ccInstrumentKey(r)+'; software version '+text(m.SWVersion)+'. Samples are grouped within each run and current selection.  if(key==='repeat'){const rows=sopInterpretationRows(null,false).filter(r=>r.outcome==='Repeat');return page(rows.length+' current sample-target groups have the exact Repeat outcome under '+text(SOP.name)+'.  if(action==='security')return pair('Identifier disclosure status: export pseudonymisation is '+(pseudoOn()?'on':'off')+'. That setting applies only to exports that implement it. Spoken sample names remain original, as you requested. No security or intrusion scan was performed; no export was started.','标识信息状态：导出假名化已'+(pseudoOn()?'开启':'关闭')+'。此设置仅作用于支持该功能的导出。按您的要求，语音样品名仍使用原名。未进行安全或入侵扫描，也未开始导出。');
 if(action==='drill:1'||action==='drill:0'){drillMode=action.endsWith('1');shipRecord('drill-state',drillMode?'enabled':'disabled');shipLabels();return pair(drillMode?'Drill label enabled.  if(action==='broadcast'){shipLabels();shipRecord('interface-state-shown','Manual indicators in workspace and Console');return pair('Workspace and Console show the manual interface label when drill mode or the manual alert is active. No automatic condition colour or all-clear status is inferred.','演练或手动警报开启时，工作区及控制台显示手动界面标记。不推断自动状态颜色或全部正常状态。');}

'+part.en,'独立界面日志，仅在本页面会话内存中保留，最多 200 项。'+part.zh);}
 if(action==='stop'){stop();sound?.stopAlert?.();sound?.stopAmbience?.();sound?.stopPreview?.();let paused=false;try{const tour=window.MISSY_DEMO_TOUR||(window.parent!==window?window.parent.MISSY_DEMO_TOUR:null);if(tour?.pause){tour.pause();paused=true;}}catch{}shipRecord('interface-stop','Voice and manual audio stopped; no reader/instrument cancellation');shipLabels();return pair('Voice, manual alert and background sounds stopped. '+(paused?'Demo pause requested. ':'')+'File intake, rendering and instrument acquisition were not halted. Loaded run views remain.','已停止语音、手动警报及背景声音。'+(paused?'已请求暂停演示。':'')+'未停止文件读取、渲染或仪器采集，已加载运行视图保留。');}

```javascript
function mount(){const host=document.querySelector('#statusbar .sb-right'),consoleBar=document.getElementById('mg-statusbar');if(!host||!consoleBar)return;
  panel=document.createElement('details');panel.id='missy-console-voice';panel.setAttribute('data-i18n-skip','');const summary=document.createElement('summary');panel.append(summary);
  const settings=document.createElement('div');settings.className='missy-voice-settings';
  setupButton=document.createElement('button');setupButton.type='button';setupButton.onclick=setup;settings.append(setupButton);
  const durationLabel=document.createElement('label'),durationText=document.createElement('span');durationInput=document.createElement('input');durationInput.type='number';durationInput.min=String(5/60);durationInput.max='60';durationInput.step='any';durationInput.value='10';durationInput.id='missy-voice-minutes';
  try{const raw=localStorage.getItem(durationKey),saved=raw===null?Number(localStorage.getItem('missy_voice_seconds_v1'))*1000:Number(raw);if(Number.isInteger(saved)&&saved>=5000&&saved<=3600000)appliedMs=saved;}catch{}durationInput.value=String(appliedMs/60000);
  confirmButton=document.createElement('button');confirmButton.type='button';confirmButton.textContent='✓';confirmButton.onclick=()=>{const n=milliseconds();if(n===null){durationInput.reportValidity();return;}appliedMs=n;try{localStorage.setItem(durationKey,String(n));}catch{}controls();say('Saved','已保存');};durationInput.addEventListener('input',controls);durationLabel.append(durationText,durationInput,confirmButton);settings.append(durationLabel);
  capabilityNote=document.createElement('p');capabilityNote.id='missy-voice-capability';capabilityNote.setAttribute('role','status');capabilityNote.setAttribute('aria-live','polite');settings.append(capabilityNote);
  status=document.createElement('p');status.setAttribute('role','status');status.setAttribute('aria-live','polite');settings.append(status);panel.append(settings);host.append(panel);
