## C10520 · <callback@3624:28>

- Ownership: MISSY first-party
- Module: core/ui/evidence_guide.js, line 2; script 11, script line 3624
- Form: ArrowFunctionExpression; parameters: ``
- AST classification: `new_or_changed_anonymous`
- R1 entry status: `observed_in_passing_scenario`
- Passing scenario observations: voice-demo, formats, training, voice-routing, voice-state, ack-queue, clarification, voice-bargein, command-finish, chart-focus, guided-tour, precision, quantstudio, evidence-keyboard
- R2 clean contract evidence: No separately linked clean contract assertion for this function
- Code SHA-256: `1b5f5e712b11a3bbc6415fb1789969c97284143f59ca4e84115c2001c1644815`
- [Complete exact function source](https://github.com/mihaiionitabio-alt/zpcrweb/blob/missy-public-offline-2026-10-20/documentation/releases/2026-10-31-full-wiki/code/functions/C10520.js)

```javascript
()=>{
 const items=[
  ['Source bytes and checksums','源文件字节与校验和','The source-byte SHA-256 identifies the loaded bytes. Native checksums use their own algorithm and scope; compare only the same method and scope. A match supports byte identity or integrity, not authenticity, operator identity or scientific validity.','源文件字节的SHA-256用于标识已加载的字节。原生校验和采用各自的算法与范围；仅可比较算法和范围相同的值。匹配可支持字节一致性或完整性，但不能证明真实性、操作者身份或科学有效性。'],
  ['Stored and independent results','保存结果与独立计算结果','MISSY displays retained vendor results separately from supported independent calculations and SOP interpretation. This preserves the original evidence for comparison. An independent result does not establish that the vendor used the same algorithm or settings.','MISSY分别显示保留的厂商结果、受支持的独立计算结果及SOP判定，便于对照原始证据。独立计算结果不能证明厂商采用了相同的算法或参数。'],
  ['Signal layers and units','信号层与单位','Readers retain the signal layers available in each format. Raw fluorescence, Rn and ΔRn have different meanings; their labels are not interchangeable. Retaining the signal basis helps assess comparisons without inventing missing transforms or converting undocumented units.','读取器保留各格式中可用的信号层。原始荧光、Rn和ΔRn含义不同，不可互换标签。保留信号依据有助于评估可比性，不推断缺失的变换，也不换算未说明的单位。'],
  ['Missing, locked and template data','缺失、加密锁定与模板数据','Evidence views describe what was decoded, retained or unavailable. A locked file or template does not supply measured results; unavailable evidence is not a zero or a negative sample. These distinctions explain coverage without adding rejection rules.','证据视图说明哪些数据已解码、已保留或不可用。锁定文件或模板不提供实测结果；不可用的证据不等于零值或阴性样本。这些区别用于解释覆盖范围，不增加拒收规则。'],
  ['Native reading statistics','原生读数统计量','The native inspector shows already-decoded statistics and dimensions where retained. A within-read SD describes that reading; it is not PCR replicate SD, between-run precision or measurement uncertainty. Undocumented tuple positions remain uninterpreted.','原生读数检查器显示已保留并解码的统计量与维度。单次读数内的标准差描述该次读数，不等于PCR重复标准差、批间精密度或测量不确定度。未说明的元组位置不作解释。'],
  ['Thermal, optical and calibration context','温度、光学与校准背景信息','Context inspectors display retained source fields and excerpts without applying corrections. A programmed setpoint is not a measured temperature, and a retained calibration value alone does not establish validity or traceability. These fields help investigate conditions without diagnosing a component failure.','背景信息检查器显示保留的源字段与摘录，不应用校正。程序设定温度不等于实测温度；仅保留校准值不能证明其有效性或计量溯源性。这些字段可辅助调查运行条件，不能据此诊断部件故障。'],
  ['Scope counts and review state','范围计数与审核状态','The scope snapshot counts existing result records using the applied user mask. Draft changes are not applied, and pending review withholds inclusion counts. Record counts are not unique samples or valid results. This identifies report scope without altering sample decisions.','范围快照按已应用的用户掩码统计现有结果记录。草稿更改尚未应用；待审核时不提供纳入计数。记录数不等于独立样本数或有效结果数。此视图用于说明报告范围，不改变样本判定。'],
  ["Display rounding", "显示舍入", "Tables, graph labels and tooltips may format a decoded value to fewer digits. Equal displayed values need not be equal underlying values. Displayed decimal places do not establish instrument resolution, accuracy or measurement uncertainty. This explanation does not change any formatter or calculation.", "表格、图形标签及提示框可能将解码数值显示为较少位数。显示相同的数值，其底层数值不一定相同。显示的小数位数不能证明仪器分辨率、准确度或测量不确定度。本说明不更改任何格式化或计算。"],
  ["Decoded values and source precision", "解码数值与源精度", "A decoded number is the value available to MISSY after the existing reader has parsed it. It does not by itself preserve the original binary bits, decimal text or the precision used by the producer before storage. Where an explicit source declaration is unavailable, source numeric precision and pre-storage rounding are unknown; do not infer them from the number of visible digits or the file extension.", "解码数值是已有读取器解析后可供MISSY使用的值。仅凭该值不能保留原始二进制位、十进制文本或生产商存储前采用的精度。未提供明确源声明时，源数值精度及存储前舍入方式均为未知；不能按可见位数或文件扩展名推断。"],
  ["Rounding and comparisons", "舍入与比较", "This disclosure adds no rounding tolerance or acceptance rule. Keep using the applicable method and its existing decisions. A rounded label is not a replacement input for recalculation or a reason to change a boundary decision. Source precision declarations, when available, must be read in their own field and algorithm context.", "本说明不增加舍入容差或验收规则。继续采用适用方法及其已有判定。舍入后的标签不能替代重新计算的输入，也不能作为更改边界判定的理由。源精度声明如有提供，应结合其字段与算法背景读取。"],
  ["Export precision limits", "导出精度界限", "Exports keep their existing serialization and formatting. A CSV, PDF or RDML value is not a guarantee of source-bit or original-decimal round-trip preservation. Keep the original files for that evidence. This static guide neither audits precision per field nor changes exported values, bytes or rounding policies.", "导出沿用已有序列化与格式。CSV、PDF或RDML中的数值不能保证往返转换后保留源二进制位或原始十进制表示。应保留原始文件作为此类证据。本静态指南既不逐字段审核精度，也不更改导出数值、字节或舍入规则。"],
  ['Export and conformance limits','导出与符合性界限','Optional CSV and PDF evidence tables describe their selected scope; they are not a complete acquisition package or authenticated audit history. Availability in an inspector is not manufacturer conformance or a report-release decision. Original files remain necessary for evidence not represented by the selected export.','可选CSV与PDF证据表仅描述其所选范围，不是完整采集数据包或经过身份认证的审计历史。检查器中可见的数据不能证明厂商符合标准，也不代表报告发布决定。对于所选导出未包含的证据，仍需保留原始文件。']
 ];
 function render(){return MISSY_EVIDENCE_A11Y.refresh('missy-evidence-guide',renderContent);}
 function renderContent(){
  const host=document.getElementById('loadedcard');if(!host)return;
  let box=document.getElementById('missy-evidence-guide');
  if(!box){box=document.createElement('details');box.id='missy-evidence-guide';box.setAttribute('data-i18n-skip','');box.addEventListener('toggle',render);host.append(box);}
  const zh=UI_LANG==='zh',title=document.createElement('summary');title.textContent=zh?'证据含义与界限（只读）':'Evidence meanings and limits (read only)';MISSY_EVIDENCE_A11Y.reset(box,title);
  if(!box.open)return;
  const dl=document.createElement('dl');for(const item of items){const dt=document.createElement('dt'),dd=document.createElement('dd');dt.textContent=item[zh?1:0];dd.textContent=item[zh?3:2];dl.append(dt,dd);}box.append(dl);
 }
 MISSY_HOOKS.use('showTab','evidence-guide/static-descriptions',265,next=>function(...args){const result=next(...args);render();return result;});
 const style=document.createElement('style');style.textContent='#missy-evidence-guide{margin-top:16px;border-top:1px solid #d8dee8;padding-top:10px}#missy-evidence-guide summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:600}#missy-evidence-guide dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(160px,300px) minmax(0,1fr);gap:10px 16px}#missy-evidence-guide dt,#missy-evidence-guide dd{margin:0;min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}#missy-evidence-guide dt{font-weight:600}@media(max-width:600px){#missy-evidence-guide dl{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}#missy-evidence-guide dd{margin-bottom:8px}}';document.head.append(style);
 document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>{render();new MutationObserver(render).observe(document.body,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class']});});
 return Object.freeze({render});
}
```

```javascript
function(root){
'use strict';
const VERSION='learning-2';
const RULES=Object.freeze({'chart.baseline':'Baseline readiness','sop.native':'Native detection status','sop.scope':'Profile applicability','integrity.absent':'No supplied checksum'});
const clone=x=>JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x));
const id=x=>JSON.stringify(x);
const ceilings=[100,70,50,30];
function grade(step,answer,hints=0){
 const truth=step.evaluate();
 const unsafe=(truth.noLimits&&answer.call==='In control') || (truth.notApplicable&&answer.call==='Negative') || (truth.acceptanceFailed&&['Positive','Negative'].includes(answer.call)) || (truth.sentinel&&answer.call==='Positive') || (truth.integrityOpen&&answer.call!==undefined&&answer.call!=='Invalid');
 const parts={};let earned=0,max=0;
 for(const [key,weight] of Object.entries(step.weights)){
  max+=weight;
  const ok=key==='value'?Number.isFinite(answer.value)&&Math.abs(answer.value-truth.value)<=(step.tolerance||0):id(answer[key])===id(truth[key]);
  parts[key]={correct:ok,earned:ok?weight:0,max:weight};earned+=parts[key].earned;
 }
 const cautious=!unsafe&&parts.call&&!parts.call.correct&&['Repeat','Inconclusive'].includes(answer.call)&&['Positive','Negative'].includes(truth.call);
 const ceiling=ceilings[Math.min(3,Math.max(0,hints))];
 return {points:unsafe?-60:Math.min(ceiling,100*earned/max-(cautious?10:0)),rawEarned:earned,rawMax:max,ceiling,unsafe:!!unsafe,retry:!!unsafe,parts,truth};
}
function rulesFor(step){return [...new Set([step.evaluate().rule,...Object.keys(RULES)])].filter(Boolean);}
function fixtures(){
 const profile=Object.freeze({id:'TRAINING-NATIVE-1',revision:'1',cutoff:40,baselineMinimum:20});
 const chart=Object.freeze({instrument:'ARTIFICIAL-CFX-2',id:'A-H2c',points:[10,11,10,12,11,10,11]});
 const rows=Array.from({length:21},(_,i)=>Object.freeze({run:'ARTIFICIAL-SC_02',well:'A'+String(i+1).padStart(2,'0'),cq:40,nativeStatus:i<19?'Undetermined':'Detected',fieldId:'nativeStatus'}));
 const baseline=()=>({call:chart.points.length<profile.baselineMinimum?'Cannot be determined':'In control',rule:'chart.baseline',noLimits:chart.points.length<profile.baselineMinimum,evidence:{kind:'chart',instrument:chart.instrument,chart:chart.id}});
 const outcome=row=>({call:row.nativeStatus==='Detected'&&row.cq<=profile.cutoff?'Positive':'Negative',rule:'sop.native',sentinel:row.nativeStatus==='Undetermined',evidence:{kind:'field',run:row.run,well:row.well,field:'nativeStatus'}});
 const step=(x)=>({...x,hints:x.hints||['Inspect the displayed evidence.','Compare it with the training profile.','Use '+(x.rule||'the declared native-status rule')+'.']});
 return {profile,chart,rows,cases:[
 {id:'chart-baseline',title:'Seven points is not a pass / 七个点不代表合格',brief:'Review the chart and the declared minimum before deciding. / 判断前请检查图表及规定的最少点数。',steps:[
 step({id:'count',prompt:'How many recorded points? / 有多少个记录点？',weights:{value:20},evaluate:()=>({value:chart.points.length,rule:'chart.baseline'})}),
 step({id:'decision',prompt:'Commit a chart status, cite its rule and select the chart. / 选择图表状态、规则及证据。',weights:{call:40,rule:40,evidence:20},calls:['In control','Outside limits','To watch','Cannot be determined'],rule:'chart.baseline',evaluate:baseline}),
 step({id:'minimum',prompt:'How many points are required? / 至少需要多少个点？',weights:{value:20},evaluate:()=>({value:profile.baselineMinimum,rule:'chart.baseline'})})]},
 {id:'sentinel',title:'The final cycle / 最后一个循环',brief:'Equal Cq numbers can retain different native statuses. This training profile explicitly accepts measured crossings through cycle 40. / 相同Cq可对应不同原始状态。本训练配置明确接受第40循环的实测交点。',steps:[
 step({id:'count',prompt:'How many rows have Cq 40? / 有多少条记录的Cq为40？',weights:{value:20},evaluate:()=>({value:rows.filter(w=>w.cq===40).length,rule:'sop.native'})}),
 step({id:'crossings',prompt:'How many are measured crossings? / 有多少个实测交点？',weights:{value:30},evaluate:()=>({value:rows.filter(w=>w.nativeStatus==='Detected').length,rule:'sop.native'})}),
 ...[0,19].map(i=>step({id:'well-'+i,prompt:'Commit a call for '+rows[i].well+'; select its distinguishing field. / 判断该孔并选择区分状态的字段。',weights:{call:40,rule:40,evidence:20},calls:['Positive','Negative','Inconclusive','Repeat','Invalid'],evaluate:()=>outcome(rows[i])}))
 ]} ]};
}
function session(data=fixtures(),identity={}){
 const records=[],latest=new Map(),usedHints=new Map();
 const find=(c,s)=>{const step=data.cases.find(x=>x.id===c)?.steps.find(x=>x.id===s);if(!step)throw Error('Unknown training step');return step;};
 return {data,records,hint(c,s){const st=find(c,s),k=c+'/'+s,n=Math.min(3,(usedHints.get(k)||0)+1);usedHints.set(k,n);return st.hints[n-1];},
 commit(c,s,answer,rationale='',latencyMs=0){const step=find(c,s),key=c+'/'+s,score=grade(step,answer,usedHints.get(key)||0);const row={scenario:c,step:s,attempt:records.filter(x=>x.scenario===c&&x.step===s).length+1,answer:clone(answer),truth:clone(score.truth),score,rationale:String(rationale),latencyMs:Math.max(0,Number(latencyMs)||0),hintsUsed:usedHints.get(key)||0,profile:clone(data.profile),moduleVersion:VERSION,...identity,at:new Date().toISOString()};records.push(row);latest.set(key,row);return clone(row);},
 summary(){const all=[...latest.values()],expected=data.cases.reduce((n,c)=>n+c.steps.length,0),mean=all.length?all.reduce((n,x)=>n+x.score.points,0)/all.length:0;return {completed:all.length,total:expected,mean,unresolvedUnsafe:all.filter(x=>x.score.unsafe).length,passed:all.length===expected&&mean>=70&&!all.some(x=>x.score.unsafe),missProfile:records.reduce((a,x)=>{const rule=x.truth.rule;a[rule]??={attempts:0,misses:0};a[rule].attempts++;if(Object.values(x.score.parts).some(p=>!p.correct)||x.score.unsafe)a[rule].misses++;return a;},{}),badges:all.length===expected&&records.every(x=>!x.score.unsafe)?['Steady Hand']:[]};}
 };
}
const api={VERSION,grade,rulesFor,fixtures,session,active:false,voice:()=>false};
if(typeof module!=='undefined')module.exports=api;
root.MISSY_LEARNING=api;
}
```

```javascript
()=>{

 async function capture(frame){const w=frame.contentWindow,doc=frame.contentDocument;await doc.fonts.ready;const canvas=await html2canvas(doc.body,{backgroundColor:'#000000',scale:Math.min(1,1280/w.innerWidth),width:w.innerWidth,height:w.innerHeight,x:w.scrollX,y:w.scrollY,windowWidth:w.innerWidth,windowHeight:w.innerHeight,scrollX:w.scrollX,scrollY:w.scrollY,logging:false,useCORS:false,allowTaint:false,ignoreElements:el=>el.id==='missy-console-voice-controls'||el.tagName==='IFRAME'});return {dataURL:canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg',.76),width:canvas.width,height:canvas.height,method:'DOM rendering of the actual training workspace; not a native operating-system screenshot',capturedAt:new Date().toISOString()};}
 function render(data){const doc=pdfDoc(),p=(s,bold=false,size=10)=>doc.para(String(s),size,bold),pretty=v=>typeof v==='object'?JSON.stringify(v):String(v??'');
 p(label('MISSY — Training record','MISSY — 学习记录'),true,18);p(label('Artificial data. Practice record, not competency certification or laboratory release.','人工模拟数据。仅为学习记录，不作为能力认证或实验室结果签发。'));doc.gap(10);

Each lesson earns points once; retries remain in the record.','记录用时，但用时不影响得分。每课仅计分一次，重试保留在记录中。'));p(label('Images are local page renderings captured from the workspace used for each answer.','图像为每次回答时所用工作区的本地页面渲染。'));doc.gap(12);
 p(label('Timeline — session elapsed time','时间线 — 会话累计用时'),true,14);for(const r of data.records){p(duration(r.sessionElapsedMs)+'  '+r.title+'  '+r.score.points+'/100  '+label('attempt ','尝试 ')+r.attempt,false,9);}

 const image=data.screenshots[lesson.id];if(image){const bytes=Uint8Array.from(atob(image.dataURL.split(',')[1]),c=>c.charCodeAt(0)),width=doc.width,height=width*image.height/image.width;doc.room(height+30);p(label('Workspace image','工作区图像'),true,10);doc.image(bytes,width,height,image.width,image.height);}else p(label('Workspace image unavailable.','工作区图像不可用。'));
 }

}
```

```javascript
async function open(i){if(!lessons[i])throw Error('Unknown training lesson');selected=null;lessonIndex=i;document.querySelectorAll('.game-evidence-focus').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('game-evidence-focus'));demo.profile();await lessons[i].open();if(lessons[i].mode==='point'){
 const res=primary(),svg=document.querySelector('#mg-chart svg');if(!svg)throw Error('Chart is not visible');const circles=[...svg.querySelectorAll('circle')].filter(c=>c.hasAttribute('cx')&&Number(c.getAttribute('r'))>=2);const points=circles.slice(0,res.pts.length);if(points.length!==res.pts.length)throw Error('Chart point bindings incomplete');points.forEach((c,index)=>{c.dataset.gamePoint=String(index);c.setAttribute('role','button');c.setAttribute('tabindex','0');c.setAttribute('aria-label',tr('Select point ','选择点 ')+(index+1));const select=()=>{hit({kind:'point',chart:'bg_median',index});c.classList.add('game-evidence-selected');};c.addEventListener('click',select);c.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();select();}});if(res.pts[index].flags.length)c.classList.add('game-evidence-focus');});}
 if(lessons[i].mode==='open')hit({kind:'opened',id:lessons[i].id});localiseTraining();return spec(i);}
```

```javascript
async function pcrdRequestPassword(){
 if(pcrdSessionPassword!==null)return pcrdSessionPassword;
 return new Promise(resolve=>{
 const d=document.createElement('dialog');d.style.cssText='background:#171f2e;color:#e5edf8;border:1px solid #40546c;border-radius:12px;width:min(560px,calc(100vw - 48px));box-sizing:border-box;max-height:90vh;overflow:auto;padding:24px';
 const h=document.createElement('h3');h.textContent='PCRD password / PCRD 密码';
 const p=document.createElement('p');p.textContent='Enter your PCRD password locally. It stays in memory until forgotten or the page closes. No upload or password is included in exports. / 密码仅保存在本页内存中，不上传或导出。';
 const input=document.createElement('input');input.type='password';input.autocomplete='off';input.setAttribute('aria-label','PCRD password');input.style.cssText='box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;padding:10px;margin-bottom:16px';
 const help=document.createElement('div');help.id='pcrd-password-help';help.style.cssText='line-height:1.5;overflow-wrap:anywhere;margin:0 0 16px;padding:12px;border:1px solid #40546c;border-radius:8px';
 const heading=document.createElement('strong');heading.textContent='Need a password? Prefer RDML? / 密码与 RDML 帮助';help.append(heading);
 const list=document.createElement('ul');list.style.cssText='padding-left:20px;margin:8px 0';
 for(const text of [
 'Standard PCRD files usually use a software-level password, not your CFX login or activation key. Ask your instrument administrator or Bio-Rad about authorised access through your licensed CFX installation. MISSY does not supply or recover passwords.',
 'Security Edition files may use a user-specific password. Ask the file owner or administrator.',
 'Without a password: open the original PCRD in licensed CFX software, then use its RDML export command. Menu names vary by CFX version. Include amplification and melt data where available.',
 'Save the exported .rdml file, cancel this prompt, and load the .rdml in MISSY using Load files. Select Read the files / Analyse as usual. Renaming .pcrd to .rdml does not convert it. RDML contains only data included by the exporter.',
 '标准 PCRD 通常使用软件级密码，并非 CFX 登录密码或激活密钥。请向仪器管理员或 Bio-Rad 咨询通过已获许可的 CFX 软件进行授权访问。MISSY 不提供或恢复密码。Security Edition 文件可能需要用户专用密码。',
 '无需密码的替代方法：在已获许可的 CFX 软件中打开 PCRD，导出 RDML（菜单因版本而异；如可用，请包含扩增和熔解数据）。保存 .rdml，取消本对话框，在 MISSY 的“加载文件”中选择该文件并读取分析。修改扩展名不能转换格式；RDML 仅包含导出的数据。'
 ]){const li=document.createElement('li');li.textContent=text;list.append(li);}help.append(list);
 input.setAttribute('aria-describedby',help.id);
 const ok=document.createElement('button');ok.textContent='Unlock / 解锁';const cancel=document.createElement('button');cancel.textContent='Cancel / 取消';cancel.style.marginLeft='10px';
 const finish=v=>{input.value='';d.close();d.remove();resolve(v);};
 ok.onclick=()=>{if(!input.value){input.focus();return;}if([...input.value].some(c=>c.charCodeAt(0)>255)){input.setCustomValidity('Password must use Latin-1 characters');input.reportValidity();return;}pcrdSessionPassword=input.value;finish(pcrdSessionPassword);};
 cancel.onclick=()=>finish(null);d.oncancel=e=>{e.preventDefault();finish(null);};input.onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'){e.preventDefault();ok.click();}};
 d.append(h,p,input,help,ok,cancel);document.body.append(d);d.showModal();input.focus();
 });
}
```

${['Well','Sample','Target','Cq','Curve evidence','Reaction use','Level ID','Assigned copies','QC pair ID'].map(x=>``).join('')}
${esc(ui(x))}
`; document.getElementById('mara-method-settings')?.after(section); const run=RUNS[ri];if(!run){section.querySelector('table').hidden=true;section.querySelector('.row').hidden=true;return;} section.querySelector('#mara-evidence-run').onchange=e=>maraRenderEvidence(Number(e.target.value)); const evidence=maraEvidence(run),input=maraInput(run),ctx=section.querySelector('#mara-input-context'); const facts=[['methodVerified','Method and reaction protocol verified']]; if(SOP.analyticalRole==='quantification')facts.push(['samePlateVerified','Same run and plate verified'],['calibrationRangeVerified','CRM dilution range and DNA inputs verified']); else if(SOP.method.standard_number===15)facts.push(['samePlateVerified','Same run and plate verified']); else if(SOP.method.standard_number===16)facts.push(['samePlateVerified','Same run and plate verified']); if(SOP.method.standard_number===17)facts.push(['rapidWorkflow','Rapid-PCR workflow verified']); if(SOP.method.standard_number===6)facts.push(['sequenceVerified','KJ1003 junction sequence verified']); if(SOP.dnaBasisDiscrepancy)facts.push(['dnaBasisVerified','GGK2 DNA basis resolved']); const changed=()=>{sopChanged();markDirty('results','graphs','review','panel');renderSopResults();}; for(const [key,label] of facts){const el=document.createElement('label');el.innerHTML=` ${esc(ui(label))}`;el.firstChild.onchange=e=>{evidence.context[key]=e.target.checked;changed();};ctx.append(el);} const body=section.querySelector('tbody'); for(const r of input.records){const w=r.source,e=evidence.reactions[r.id]||(evidence.reactions[r.id]={});const tr=document.createElement('tr'); tr.innerHTML=`${esc(w.well||w.pos)}${esc(r.sample)}${esc(w.target||w.analysis)}${Number.isFinite(r.cq)?r.cq:'—'}`; for(const el of tr.querySelectorAll('[data-key]'))el.onchange=()=>{e[el.dataset.key]=el.type==='number'?(el.value===''?'':Number(el.value)):el.value;changed();};body.append(tr); } const stamp=()=>({schema:'missy-mara-inputs/1',source_sha256:run.meta?.sourceSHA256||'',sop_sha256:sopHash()});
```javascript
function reportGraphAvailable(g,ri){
 const run=RUNS[ri];if(!run||run.pcrdLocked||typeof g.render!=='function')return false;
 if(g.scope==='run'&&(run.rawOnly||run.zpcr||run.pcrd))return false;
 let cache=REPORT_GRAPH_AVAILABILITY.get(run);if(!cache){cache=new WeakMap();REPORT_GRAPH_AVAILABILITY.set(run,cache);}
 const key=[APP_STATE.generation,RUNS.length,SAMPLE_SELECTION.revision,sopHash(),JSON.stringify(SEL_STATE.options['img:'+g.id]||{}),ZPCR_ENDPOINT_N].join('|'),old=cache.get(g);
 if(old?.key===key)return old.available;
 let available=false;try{const f=reportGraphFigure(g,ri);available=Array.isArray(f.rows)&&f.rows.length>0;}catch(e){/* Unavailable evidence is hidden; decoder/renderer errors still surface in their own views. */}
 cache.set(g,{key,available});return available;
}
```

```javascript
function reportItemVisible(item){
 if(!item||!item.ready())return false;
 if(item.reportGraph){if(!RUNS.some(r=>!r.rawOnly&&!r.pcrdLocked))return false;const run=RUNS[selRunIndex()];if(SEL_STATE.figureScope!=='all'&&(run?.rawOnly||run?.pcrdLocked))return false;return true;}
 if(item.kind==='data'){try{return item.rows().length>0;}catch(e){return false;}}
 if(item.reportAcquisition&&!item.reportPanel.series.some(s=>s.points.some(p=>Number.isFinite(p[1]))))return false;
 if(item.independentGroup){const g=item.independentGroup,metric=item.pcrdMetric.includes('Tm')?'Tm':'Cq';const valid=item.independentComparison?piComparisons().some(r=>r._group===g&&r.metric===metric&&Number.isFinite(r.delta)):g.records.some(r=>Number.isFinite(metric==='Tm'?r.tm.value:r.cq.value));if(!valid)return false;}
 if(SEL_STATE.figureScope!=='all'&&item.kind==='image'){
  const run=RUNS[selRunIndex()];
  if(item.reportAcquisition)return item.reportAcquisition.runs.includes(run)&&item.reportPanel.series.some(s=>s.points.some(p=>Number.isFinite(p[1])));
  if(item.cfxRun)return item.cfxRun===run;
  if(item.independentGroup)return item.independentGroup.run===run&&item.independentGroup.records.some(r=>Number.isFinite(item.pcrdMetric.includes('Tm')?r.tm.value:r.cq.value));
  if(item.id.startsWith('img:pcrd_'))return !!run?.pcrd&&String(item.note).includes(run.file);
 }
 return true;
}
```

    2 · Targets, Cq cut-offs and late-signal zone

    Rows are tried top to bottom; the first whose pattern matches the target name applies. Patterns: 35S|P35S, wildcards HMG*, * for anything, or a regular expression written as /^tNOS/. A Cq above the cut-off counts as not detected. A mean Cq above the late-signal limit, or a quantity below the minimum, gets the late-signal outcome.

    ${L?"":``}
    3 · Controls: which wells, what they must show, how many per run

    Match by the sample name (patterns as above) or by the resolved role (NTC, Blank, Negative control, Positive control, Calibrator, Standard). Leave the Cq range empty when any detection is acceptable.

    4 · Replicates and internal control

    6 · Outcomes, colours and report wording

    Placeholders: {sample} {target} {cq} {sd} {det} {n} {cutoff} {reason} {outcome} {run}. The colours are used by every SOP graph.

```javascript
function niceTicks(lo,hi,n){
  if(!Number.isFinite(lo)||!Number.isFinite(hi))return [];
  if(lo===hi){lo-=1;hi+=1;}
  const step0=(hi-lo)/(n||5),mag=Math.pow(10,Math.floor(Math.log10(step0))),err=step0/mag;
  const step=(err>=7.5?10:err>=3.5?5:err>=1.5?2:1)*mag,out=[];
  for(let k=Math.ceil(lo/step);k*step<=hi+step*1e-9;k++)out.push(+(k*step).toPrecision(12));
  return out;
}
```

```javascript
function svgPlot(o){
  if(PLOT_CAPTURE)PLOT_CAPTURE.push(o);   /* interactive view only; see ixMount */
  const W=o.width||880,H=o.height||440,L=o.left||70,Rm=o.right||(o.legend&&o.legend.length?170:20),T=o.top||30,B=o.bottom||50;
  const pw=W-L-Rm,ph=H-T-B;
  const ylog=!!o.ylog;
  const fy=v=>ylog?Math.log10(v):v;
  let [x0,x1]=o.x,[y0,y1]=o.y;
  if(ylog){y0=Math.log10(Math.max(y0,1e-9));y1=Math.log10(Math.max(y1,1e-9));}
  if(x0===x1){x0-=1;x1+=1;}if(y0===y1){y0-=1;y1+=1;}
  const X=v=>L+(v-x0)/(x1-x0)*pw,Y=v=>T+(1-(fy(v)-y0)/(y1-y0))*ph;
  let s=`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" width="${W}" height="${H}" font-family="system-ui,Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif" font-size="11"><rect width="${W}" height="${H}" fill="#fff"/>`;
  if(o.title)s+=`<text x="${L}" y="18" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#111827">${svgEsc(o.title)}</text>`;
  (o.bands||[]).forEach(b=>{const ya=Y(b.y1),yb=Y(b.y0);if(b.x0!=null){s+=`<rect x="${X(b.x0)}" y="${T}" width="${Math.max(0,X(b.x1)-X(b.x0))}" height="${ph}" fill="${b.colour}" opacity="${b.opacity||0.12}"/>`;}
    else s+=`<rect x="${L}" y="${Math.min(ya,yb)}" width="${pw}" height="${Math.abs(yb-ya)}" fill="${b.colour}" opacity="${b.opacity||0.12}"/>`;});
  let yt=o.yticks===false?[]:ylog?niceTicks(y0,y1,5).filter(v=>Number.isInteger(v)):niceTicks(y0,y1,6);
  if(ylog&&o.yticks!==false&&yt.length<3){                 // less than ~2 decades: also label 2× and 5×
    yt=[];for(let d=Math.floor(y0);d<=Math.ceil(y1);d++)for(const m of [1,2,5]){const v=d+Math.log10(m);if(v>=y0-1e-9&&v<=y1+1e-9)yt.push(v);}}
  const ylab10=v=>{const x=Math.pow(10,v);return x>=1e4||x<0.01?x.toExponential(0).replace("+",""):fmtTick(+x.toPrecision(2));};
  yt.forEach(v=>{const y=T+(1-(v-y0)/(y1-y0))*ph;if(y<T-0.5||y>T+ph+0.5)return;s+=`<line x1="${L}" x2="${L+pw}" y1="${y}" y2="${y}" stroke="#e5e7eb"/><text x="${L-6}" y="${y+3.5}" text-anchor="end" fill="#6b7280">${ylog?ylab10(v):fmtTick(v)}</text>`;});
  const xt=o.xticks||niceTicks(x0,x1,8).map(v=>({v,label:fmtTick(v)}));
  xt.forEach(t=>{const x=X(t.v);if(x<L-0.5||x>L+pw+0.5)return;s+=`<line x1="${x}" x2="${x}" y1="${T+ph}" y2="${T+ph+4}" stroke="#9ca3af"/><text x="${x}" y="${T+ph+16}" text-anchor="${t.anchor||"middle"}" fill="#6b7280"${t.rotate?` transform="rotate(${t.rotate} ${x} ${T+ph+16})"`:""}>${svgEsc(t.label)}</text>`;});
  s+=`<rect x="${L}" y="${T}" width="${pw}" height="${ph}" fill="none" stroke="#9ca3af"/>`;
  if(o.xlab)s+=`<text x="${L+pw/2}" y="${H-8}" text-anchor="middle" fill="#374151">${svgEsc(o.xlab)}</text>`;
  if(o.ylab)s+=`<text transform="translate(16 ${T+ph/2}) rotate(-90)" text-anchor="middle" fill="#374151">${svgEsc(o.ylab)}</text>`;
  const cid="pc"+(++SVG_CLIP_N);
  s+=`<defs><clipPath id="${cid}"><rect x="${L}" y="${T}" width="${pw}" height="${ph}"/></clipPath></defs><g clip-path="url(#${cid})">`;
  (o.series||[]).forEach(se=>{
    const pts=se.data.filter(p=>Number.isFinite(p[0])&&Number.isFinite(p[1])&&(!ylog||p[1]>0));
    if(se.type==="line"){if(pts.length<2&&!pts.length)return;
      s+=`<polyline fill="none" stroke="${se.colour}" stroke-width="${se.width||1.3}" stroke-opacity="${se.opacity||0.9}"${se.dash?` stroke-dasharray="${se.dash}"`:""} points="${pts.map(p=>`${X(p[0]).toFixed(1)},${Y(p[1]).toFixed(1)}`).join(" ")}"><title>${svgEsc(se.tip||se.label||"")}</title></polyline>`;}
    else if(se.type==="bar"){const bw=se.barWidth||Math.max(2,pw/((x1-x0)||1)*0.7);
      pts.forEach(p=>{const base=p[2]??(ylog?Math.pow(10,y0):Math.max(y0,0));const ya=Y(p[1]),yb=Y(base);
        s+=`<rect x="${X(p[0])-bw/2+(se.offset||0)}" y="${Math.min(ya,yb)}" width="${bw}" height="${Math.abs(yb-ya)}" fill="${p[4]||se.colour}"><title>${svgEsc(p[3]||"")}</title></rect>`;});}
    else pts.forEach(p=>{s+=`<circle cx="${X(p[0]).toFixed(1)}" cy="${Y(p[1]).toFixed(1)}" r="${se.r||3.5}" fill="${p[3]||se.colour}" fill-opacity="${se.opacity||0.85}" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="0.6"><title>${svgEsc(p[2]||se.label||"")}</title></circle>`;});
  });
  s+=`</g>`;
  (o.hlines||[]).forEach(h=>{if(!Number.isFinite(h.y)||(ylog&&h.y<=0))return;const y=Y(h.y);if(y<T||y>T+ph)return;
    s+=`<line x1="${L}" x2="${L+pw}" y1="${y}" y2="${y}" stroke="${h.colour||"#111"}" stroke-dasharray="${h.dash||"5 4"}" stroke-width="1.2"/>${o.hlabelsOutside?`<text x="${L+pw+5}" y="${y+3.5}" text-anchor="start" fill="${h.colour||"#111"}">${svgEsc(h.label||"")}</text>`:`<text x="${L+pw-4}" y="${y-4}" text-anchor="end" fill="${h.colour||"#111"}">${svgEsc(h.label||"")}</text>`}`;});
  (o.vlines||[]).forEach(h=>{if(!Number.isFinite(h.x))return;const x=X(h.x);if(x<L||x>L+pw)return;
    s+=`<line x1="${x}" x2="${x}" y1="${T}" y2="${T+ph}" stroke="${h.colour||"#111"}" stroke-dasharray="${h.dash||"5 4"}" stroke-width="1.2"/><text x="${x>L+pw*0.75?x-4:x+4}" text-anchor="${x>L+pw*0.75?"end":"start"}" y="${T+12+(h.row||0)*13}" fill="${h.colour||"#111"}">${svgEsc(h.label||"")}</text>`;});
  if(o.texts)o.texts.forEach(t=>{s+=`<text x="${t.px!=null?t.px:X(t.x)}" y="${t.py!=null?t.py:Y(t.y)}" fill="${t.colour||"#374151"}" font-size="${t.size||11}" text-anchor="${t.anchor||"start"}">${svgEsc(t.text)}</text>`;});
  if(o.legend&&o.legend.length){let y=T+4;const shown=o.legend.slice(0,24);
    shown.forEach(l=>{s+=`<rect x="${L+pw+12}" y="${y}" width="11" height="11" rx="2" fill="${l.colour}"/><text x="${L+pw+28}" y="${y+9.5}" fill="#374151">${svgEsc(String(l.label).slice(0,o.legendChars||24))}</text>`;y+=16;});
    if(o.legend.length>24)s+=`<text x="${L+pw+12}" y="${y+9}" fill="#6b7280">+${o.legend.length-24} more</text>`;}
  return s+`</svg>`;
}
```

```javascript
      xanchor:o.hlabelsOutside?"left":"right",yanchor:"bottom",text:String(h.label),

  (o.vlines||[]).forEach(v=>{if(!Number.isFinite(v.x))return;

    yaxis:{title:{text:o.ylab||"",font:{size:11,color:"#374151"}},type:ylog?"log":"linear",range:yr,
```

```javascript
function ixMount(box,specs,on){
  ixPurge();
  if(!box)return false;
  const old=box.querySelector(".ix-svg-hold");
  if(old){while(old.firstChild)box.insertBefore(old.firstChild,old);old.remove();}
  box.querySelectorAll(".ix-plot").forEach(el=>el.remove());
  specs=(specs||[]).filter(Boolean);
  if(!on||!ixReady()||!specs.length)return false;
  if(!specs.some(o=>ixTraces(o).length))return false;   /* nothing plottable: keep the drawn SVG */
  const hold=document.createElement("div");hold.className="ix-svg-hold";hold.style.display="none";
  while(box.firstChild)hold.appendChild(box.firstChild);
  box.appendChild(hold);
  const made=[];
  specs.forEach(o=>{
    const d=document.createElement("div");d.className="ix-plot";box.appendChild(d);
    try{
      /* newPlot finishes asynchronously. If the figure is replaced or released
         before it settles, the remainder of that promise has nothing to work on;
         the rejection is swallowed here instead of surfacing as a page error. */
      const pr=Plotly.newPlot(d,ixTraces(o),ixLayout(o),{responsive:true,displaylogo:false,
        modeBarButtonsToRemove:["lasso2d","select2d"],
        toImageButtonOptions:{format:"svg",filename:"chart",width:o.width||880,height:o.height||440}});
      if(pr&&pr.then)pr.then(null,()=>{});
      made.push(d);IX_MOUNTED.push(d);
    }catch(e){console.error("interactive chart:",e);d.remove();}
  });
  if(!made.length){ // put the drawn SVG back
    while(hold.firstChild)box.insertBefore(hold.firstChild,hold);hold.remove();return false;
  }
  return true;
}
```

```javascript
function ssLearnNames(rows,scope="experiment",sensitivity="balanced"){
  const groups=new Map(),out=new Map(),models=[];
  rows.forEach(r=>{const k=scope==="all"?"All experiments":r.experiment+"\u0000"+r.ri;if(!groups.has(k))groups.set(k,[]);groups.get(k).push(r);});
  const minShare={sensitive:.10,balanced:.15,strict:.25}[sensitivity]||.15;
  groups.forEach((items,key)=>{
    const names=new Map();items.filter(r=>!ssNameControl(r)&&r.targets.length&&!/^\(unnamed well /.test(r.sample)).forEach(r=>names.set(r.sample,ssNameTemplate(r.sample)));
    const counts=new Map();names.forEach(t=>counts.set(t,(counts.get(t)||0)+1));
    const ranked=[...counts].sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]||a[0].localeCompare(b[0]));
    const n=names.size,dominant=n>=8&&ranked.length&&ranked[0][1]/n>=.35;
    const common=new Set(dominant?ranked.filter(([,count])=>count>=Math.max(3,Math.ceil(n*minShare))).map(([t])=>t):[]);
    models.push({scope:key.split("\u0000")[0],n,common:[...common],ready:!!dominant});
    items.forEach(r=>{const template=ssNameTemplate(r.sample);let kind,reason;
      if(ssNameControl(r)){kind="control";reason="Control or standard: reviewed separately, not used to learn routine sample names.";}
      else if(!r.targets.length){kind="unavailable";reason="No analysed result: not used to learn sample-name patterns.";}
      else if(n<8){kind="unavailable";reason=`Only ${n} distinct sample names in this scope; at least 8 are needed.`;}
      else if(!dominant){kind="mixed";reason="No naming template covers at least 35% of distinct names; no unusual-name claim is made.";}
      else if(common.has(template)){kind="usual";reason=`Matches a common template (${counts.get(template)}/${n} distinct names): ${template}`;}
      else{kind="unusual";reason=`Less common template (${counts.get(template)||0}/${n} distinct names): ${template}. Common: ${[...common].join("; ")}`;}
      const title={control:"Controls / standards",unavailable:"Insufficient naming data",mixed:"Mixed naming patterns",usual:"Common naming pattern",unusual:"Unusual name pattern"}[kind];
      out.set(r.key,{kind,template,reason,group:title+(kind==="usual"||kind==="unusual"?" — "+template:"")});
    });
  });return {out,models};
}
```

```javascript
(c){
    const ev=runTimeline(c.run);if(!ev.length)return {svg:svgMessage("The file carries no dated events."),rows:[]};
    const T=runTimes(c.run),ref=Number.isFinite(T.start)?T.start:ev[0].time,near=ev.filter(e=>Math.abs(e.time-ref)<7*864e5);
    const lo=Math.min(...near.map(e=>e.time)),hi=Math.max(...near.map(e=>e.time)),span=(hi-lo)||3600000;
    const toH=t=>(Math.max(lo,Math.min(hi,t))-ref)/3600000;
    const cols={file:"#2563eb",run:"#16a34a",analysis:"#7c3aed",edit:"#dc2626",calibration:"#d97706"};
    const series=ev.map((e,i)=>({type:"points",r:5,colour:cols[e.kind],data:[[toH(e.time),ev.length-i,`${e.what}: ${sopFmtTime(e.time)}`,cols[e.kind]]]}));
    if(Number.isFinite(T.start)&&Number.isFinite(T.end))series.unshift({type:"bar",colour:"#bbf7d0",barWidth:0,data:[]});
    const height=Math.max(260,ev.length*20+90);
    const texts=ev.map((e,i)=>{const off=e.time<lo||e.time>hi;return {x:toH(e.time),y:ev.length-i,text:`  ${e.what}${off?` (${sopFmtTime(e.time)})`:""}`,colour:off?"#9ca3af":"#374151",anchor:toH(e.time)>((hi-ref)/3600000+(lo-ref)/3600000)/2?"end":"start"};});
    const svg=svgPlot({title:runName(c.run),height,x:[(lo-ref)/3600000-span/3600000*0.05,(hi-ref)/3600000+span/3600000*0.05],y:[0,ev.length+1],
      xlab:`Hours from run start (${sopFmtTime(ref)})`,ylab:"",series,texts,
      bands:Number.isFinite(T.start)&&Number.isFinite(T.end)?[{x0:0,x1:(T.end-ref)/3600000,colour:"#16a34a",opacity:0.1}]:[],
      legend:Object.entries(cols).map(([k,v])=>({label:{file:"file",run:"run",analysis:"analysis",edit:"change / save",calibration:"calibration"}[k],colour:v}))});
    return {svg,rows:ev.map(e=>({event:e.what,time:sopFmtTime(e.time),hours_from_run_start:+((e.time-ref)/3600000).toFixed(3),kind:e.kind,read_from:e.source}))};
  }
```

```javascript
(c){
```

```javascript
      xlab:"Mean Cq",ylab:"SD of Cq",series,legend:legendFromMap(cm),
      hlines:SOP.graphs.showSdLimit?[{y:sopNum(SOP.replicates.maxSd),label:`SOP max SD ${SOP.replicates.maxSd}`,colour:"#b91c1c"}]:[]}),
      rows:pts.map(r=>({sample:r.sample,target:r.target,n:r.n,detected:r.det,cq_mean:r.cqMean,cq_sd:r.cqSd,outcome:r.outcome}))};
  }
```

```javascript
(c){return MISSY_HOOKS.invoke("GRAPHS.stdcurve.render",this,[c],function(c){
    const scs=sopStdCurves(c.run).filter(s=>!c.target||s.target===c.target);
    if(!scs.length)return {svg:svgMessage("No standards with a stored quantity in this run / target."),rows:[]};
    const cm=new Map(),series=[],texts=[];let ty=46;
    scs.forEach(sc=>{const col=catColour(cm,sc.target);
      series.push({type:"points",colour:col,data:sc.points.map(p=>[p.x,p.y,graphHoverLabel(c.run,{well:p.well,sample:p.sample},`${sc.target} · ${p.conc} · Cq ${num(p.y,2)} · residual ${num(p.residual,3)}`)])});
      const xs=sc.points.map(p=>p.x),a=Math.min(...xs),b=Math.max(...xs);
      series.push({type:"line",colour:col,data:[[a,sc.intercept+sc.slope*a],[b,sc.intercept+sc.slope*b]]});
      const R=SOP.run,ok=sc.r2>=R.minR2&&sc.efficiency>=R.effMin&&sc.efficiency<=R.effMax&&sc.logs>=R.minLogs&&sc.monotonic;
      texts.push({px:80,py:ty,colour:ok?"#15803d":"#b91c1c",text:`${sc.target}: slope ${num(sc.slope,3)} · R² ${num(sc.r2,4)} (≥${R.minR2}) · E ${sc.efficiency>1000||sc.efficiency<-100?"out of range":num(sc.efficiency,1)+" %"} (${R.effMin}–${R.effMax}) · ${num(sc.logs,1)} logs (≥${R.minLogs})${sc.monotonic?"":" · out of order"} — ${ok?"within SOP":"outside SOP"}`});ty+=15;
    });
    const all=scs.flatMap(s=>s.points);
    return {svg:svgPlot({title:runName(c.run),x:extent(all.map(p=>p.x)),y:extent(all.map(p=>p.y),0.25),xlab:"log10 quantity (stored)",ylab:"Stored Cq",series,texts,legend:legendFromMap(cm)}),
      rows:scs.flatMap(s=>s.points.map(p=>({target:s.target,well:p.well,sample:p.sample,quantity:p.conc,log10_quantity:p.x,cq:p.y,fitted:s.intercept+s.slope*p.x,residual:p.residual,slope:s.slope,intercept:s.intercept,r2:s.r2,efficiency_percent:s.efficiency})))};
  });}
```

```javascript
(c){
    const ctrl=SOP.controls[Number(c.control)];if(!ctrl)return {svg:svgMessage("Define a control in the SOP (section 3)."),rows:[]};
    const all=gByDate(sopEvaluateAll(),e=>e.run),pts=[],tk=gRunTicks(all.map(e=>e.run));
    all.forEach((e,i)=>e.rows.filter(r=>r.ctrl===ctrl&&(!c.target||r.target===c.target)).forEach(r=>pts.push({i,e,r})));
    if(!pts.length)return {svg:svgMessage("The chosen control was not found in the loaded runs."),rows:[]};
    if(!pts.some(p=>Number.isFinite(p.r.cqMean)))return {svg:svgMessage(`${ctrl.name}${c.target?" · "+c.target:""}: no Cq in any of the ${pts.length} control result(s) in ${uniq(pts.map(p=>p.i)).length} run(s)${ctrl.expect==="negative"?" — as expected for a negative control":""}. Choose a positive control to see a Levey-Jennings chart.`),
      rows:pts.map(p=>({experiment:runName(p.e.run),sample:p.r.sample,target:p.r.target,cq_mean:p.r.cqMean,detected:p.r.det,n:p.r.n,outcome:p.r.outcome}))};
    const cm=new Map(),series=[],det=pts.filter(p=>Number.isFinite(p.r.cqMean));
    byKey(pts,p=>p.r.target).forEach((ps,t)=>series.push({type:"points",colour:catColour(cm,t),r:4.5,data:ps.map(p=>[p.i,Number.isFinite(p.r.cqMean)?p.r.cqMean:NaN,graphHoverLabel(p.e.run,{well:p.r.wells&&p.r.wells[0]&&p.r.wells[0].well,sample:p.r.sample},`${t} · ${num(p.r.cqMean,2)} · ${p.r.label}`)])}));
    byKey(det,p=>`${p.r.target}|${p.r.sample}|${ccInstrumentKey(p.e.run)}|${ccProtocolKey(p.e.run)}`).forEach((ps,t)=>series.push({type:"line",colour:cm.get(t),width:1,opacity:0.5,data:ps.map(p=>[p.i,p.r.cqMean])}));
    const v=det.map(p=>p.r.cqMean),m=mean(v),s=sd(v),hl=[];
    const lo=sopNum(ctrl.cqLo),hi=sopNum(ctrl.cqHi),bands=[];
    if(Number.isFinite(lo)||Number.isFinite(hi))bands.push({y0:Number.isFinite(lo)?lo:0,y1:Number.isFinite(hi)?hi:60,colour:"#16a34a",opacity:0.1});
    const ys=v.concat(hl.map(h=>h.y)).concat([lo,hi].filter(Number.isFinite));
    return {svg:svgPlot({title:`${ctrl.name}${c.target?" · "+c.target:""} — ${det.length}/${pts.length} detected`,x:[-0.6,all.length-0.4],y:extent(ys.length?ys:[0,40],0.1),
      xticks:tk.xticks,bottom:tk.bottom,xlab:tk.xlab,
      ylab:"Mean Cq",series,hlines:hl,bands,legend:legendFromMap(cm)}),
      rows:pts.map(p=>({experiment:runName(p.e.run),sample:p.r.sample,target:p.r.target,cq_mean:p.r.cqMean,detected:p.r.det,n:p.r.n,outcome:p.r.outcome}))};
  }
```

```javascript
function graphAnalysisControl(w){
```

```javascript
function graphAnalysisStats(curve){
  const v=(curve||[]).map(Number).filter(Number.isFinite);
  if(v.length<5)return null;
  const k=Math.max(3,Math.floor(v.length*.2));
  const baseValues=v.slice(0,k);
  const first=mean(baseValues),last=mean(v.slice(-k));
  const baselineSd=sd(baseValues);
  const diffs=v.slice(1).map((x,i)=>x-v[i]).filter(Number.isFinite);
  const maxSlope=diffs.length?Math.max(...diffs):NaN;
  const maxSlopeCycle=diffs.length?diffs.indexOf(maxSlope)+2:NaN;
  const curvature=diffs.slice(1).map((x,i)=>x-diffs[i]).filter(Number.isFinite);
  const maxCurvature=curvature.length?Math.max(...curvature):NaN;
  const maxCurvatureCycle=curvature.length?curvature.indexOf(maxCurvature)+3:NaN;
  const tailK=Math.max(5,Math.floor(v.length*.25));
  const tailBase=mean(v.slice(Math.max(0,v.length-2*tailK),Math.max(0,v.length-tailK)));
  const tailDiffs=v.slice(Math.max(1,v.length-tailK)).map((x,i)=>x-v[Math.max(0,v.length-tailK)-1+i]).filter(Number.isFinite);
  return {n:v.length,baseline:first,baselineSd,late:last,lateDelta:last-first,amplitude:Math.max(...v)-Math.min(...v),
    risingFraction:diffs.length?diffs.filter(x=>x>0).length/diffs.length:0,
    maxSlope,maxSlopeCycle,maxCurvature,maxCurvatureCycle,
    terminalDelta:last-tailBase,terminalRisingFraction:tailDiffs.length?tailDiffs.filter(x=>x>0).length/tailDiffs.length:0};
}
```

- [Complete exact function source](https://github.com/mihaiionitabio-alt/zpcrweb/blob/missy-public-offline-2026-10-20/documentation/releases/2026-10-31-full-wiki/code/functions/C06407.js)

```javascript
function graphAnalysisRows(run,targetKey,sampleName){
  if(!run)return [];
  const selectedKey=String(targetKey||"");
  const wells=ssWells(run).filter(w=>{
    if(!w||!Array.isArray(w.curve)||!Number.isFinite(Number(w.channel)))return false;
    if(sampleName&&String(w.sample||"")!==String(sampleName))return false;
    if(!selectedKey||selectedKey===ORPHAN_CURVE_KEY)return true;
    return [w.analysisUid,w.analysis,w.target].some(v=>String(v||"")===selectedKey);
  });
  const byChannel=new Map();
  wells.forEach(w=>{const k=String(Number(w.channel));if(!byChannel.has(k))byChannel.set(k,[]);byChannel.get(k).push({w,s:graphAnalysisStats(w.curve)});});
  const out=[];
  byChannel.forEach((items,k)=>{
    const baselines=items.map(x=>x.s&&x.s.baseline).filter(Number.isFinite).sort((a,b)=>a-b);
    const baselineMedian=baselines.length?median(baselines):NaN;
    const deviations=baselines.map(x=>Math.abs(x-baselineMedian)).sort((a,b)=>a-b);
    const baselineMad=deviations.length?median(deviations):0;
    const baselineLimit=baselineMedian+Math.max(10,3*1.4826*baselineMad);
    const posAmps=items.filter(x=>x.s&&((/positive/i.test(String(x.w.call||"")))||Number(x.w.CpRaw)>0)).map(x=>x.s.amplitude).filter(Number.isFinite).sort((a,b)=>a-b);
    const referenceAmplitude=posAmps.length?median(posAmps):NaN;
    items.filter(x=>graphAnalysisControl(x.w)).forEach(({w,s})=>{
      if(!s)return;
      const signalFloor=Math.max(3,Number.isFinite(referenceAmplitude)?referenceAmplitude*.05:0);
      /* Match the forensic rising-curve rule and also catch a monotone terminal rise:
         a late segment can be meaningful even when early baseline noise lowers the whole-run fraction. */
      const wholeRunRise=s.lateDelta>=.45*s.amplitude&&s.risingFraction>=.55;
      const terminalRise=s.terminalDelta>=Math.max(10,.25*s.amplitude)&&s.terminalRisingFraction>=.8;
      const lateRise=s.amplitude>=signalFloor&&(wholeRunRise||terminalRise);
      const highBaseline=Number.isFinite(baselineMedian)&&s.baseline>baselineLimit&&s.baseline-baselineMedian>=10;
      if(!lateRise&&!highBaseline)return;
      const hasAnswer=resultAnswers(w);
      const assessment=lateRise
        ? `Late rising trace${hasAnswer?" with a stored answer":" without a same-channel Cq/no-crossing answer"}`
        : "High raw baseline relative to wells on the same channel";
      out.push({well:w.well||"",sample:w.sample||"",target:w.target||w.analysis||"",channel:w.channel,
        baseline:s.baseline,baseline_sd:s.baselineSd,reference_baseline:baselineMedian,late_delta:s.lateDelta,terminal_delta:s.terminalDelta,amplitude:s.amplitude,curve:w.curve,
        max_slope:s.maxSlope,max_slope_cycle:s.maxSlopeCycle,max_curvature:s.maxCurvature,max_curvature_cycle:s.maxCurvatureCycle,
        rising_fraction:s.risingFraction,terminal_rising_fraction:s.terminalRisingFraction,stored_call:w.call||"",assessment,
        severity:lateRise?"error":"review",lateRise,highBaseline});
    });
  });
  return out;
}
```

```javascript
function graphAllZip(){
  if(!RUNS.length)return;
  const ri=Number($("#g-run").value)||0,entries=[];
  GRAPHS.forEach(g=>{
    const targets=[""];
    const controls=(g.opts||[]).includes("control")
      ?SOP.controls.map((x,i)=>({i,x})).filter(({x})=>x.expect==="positive")
      :[{i:0,x:null}];
    targets.forEach(t=>controls.forEach(({i,x})=>{try{
      const c={g,ri,run:RUNS[ri],target:t,metric:"outcome",signal:"stored",log:false,colourby:"outcome",level:"end",control:String(i)};
      const suffix=x?"_"+safeName(x.name||x.match||String(i)):"";
      const res=g.render(c);const base=(g.scope==="run"?"run_":"all_runs_")+g.id+suffix;
      entries.push({name:base+".svg",data:res.svg});
      if(res.rows&&res.rows.length)entries.push({name:base+".csv",data:csvOf(res.rows)});
    }catch(e){entries.push({name:g.id+"_error.txt",data:String(e.message)});}}));
  });
  entries.push({name:"sop_profile.json",data:sopJSON()});
  entries.push(...reviewBundleEntries());
  entries.push({name:"README.txt",data:`Graphs and review exports for ${runName(RUNS[ri])} (run-level) and all ${RUNS.length} loaded run(s) (cross-run).\nSOP profile ${SOP.name} v${SOP.version}, SHA-256 ${sopHash()}.\nEach graph .csv holds the numbers behind the .svg of the same name. The review/ folder contains the plate map, sample comparison, statistics, control-chart, runs/QC, amplification-curve and instrument-record exports.\n`});
  download(safeName(runName(RUNS[ri]))+"_graphs.zip",makeStoredZip(entries),"application/zip");
}
```

```javascript
function wireGraphs(){
```

```javascript
function renderTab(name){
  if(!DIRTY.has(name))return;DIRTY.delete(name);APP_STATE.activeTab=name;
  const t0=performance.now?performance.now():Date.now();
  try{
    if(name==="load"){renderLoaded();renderDerived();}
    else if(name==="export")renderExports();
    else if(name==="sop")renderSop();
    else if(name==="results")renderResults();
    else if(name==="graphs")renderGraphs();
    else if(name==="panel")renderPanel();
    else if(name==="integrity")renderIntegrity();
    else if(name==="review"){["overview","plate","compare","statistics","controls","runs","curves","rising","instrument"].forEach(s=>DIRTY.add("review:"+s));renderReviewSheetLazy(currentReviewSheet());}
  }catch(e){
    appError(`render:${name}`,e);
    const target=document.querySelector("#tab-"+name);
    if(target)target.insertAdjacentHTML("afterbegin",`<div class="notice bad">This view could not be rendered. The diagnostic record contains the error: <code>${esc(e.message||e)}</code></div>`);
  }finally{localizeDOM(document.querySelector("#tab-"+name)||document.body);
    const ms=(performance.now?performance.now():Date.now())-t0;
    APP_STATS.lastRender={tab:name,ms};APP_STATS.renders[name]=Math.round(ms);
    if(ms>APP_STATS.maxRenderMs)APP_STATS.maxRenderMs=ms;
    appStatusPaint();}
}
```

```javascript
()=>{
 const t=(en,zh)=>UI_LANG==='zh'?zh:en;
 function snapshot(runs){
  const views=runs.map((run,i)=>{const meta=run.meta||{},hash=meta.sourceSHA256;return {view:i+1,filename:run.file||'',source_sha256:typeof hash==='string'?hash:'',source_bytes:Number.isSafeInteger(meta.sourceBytes)&&meta.sourceBytes>=0?meta.sourceBytes:null,hash_available:typeof hash==='string'&&/^[a-f\d]{64}$/i.test(hash)};});

  return views;
 }

 function render(){return MISSY_EVIDENCE_A11Y.refresh('missy-source-matches',renderContent);}
 function renderContent(){
  const host=document.getElementById('loadedcard');if(!host)return;let box=document.getElementById('missy-source-matches');
  if(!box){box=document.createElement('details');box.id='missy-source-matches';box.setAttribute('data-i18n-skip','');box.addEventListener('toggle',render);host.append(box);}
  box.hidden=!RUNS.length;const title=document.createElement('summary');title.textContent=t('Views sharing source identity (read only)','共享源文件标识的视图（只读）');MISSY_EVIDENCE_A11Y.reset(box,title);if(!box.open)return;
  const p=document.createElement('p');p.textContent=t('Compares existing source SHA-256 metadata only; no files are rehashed. Counts include the current decoded view, not files or duplicate analyses: one source may contain several valid views. Names do not establish identity. No views, companions, cohorts or results are suppressed or changed. Matching metadata is not authentication, acquisition-content identity or a new integrity verdict.','仅比较已有源文件SHA-256元数据；不重新计算文件哈希。计数包含当前解码视图，不是文件数或重复分析数：一个源文件可包含多个有效视图。名称不能确立身份标识。不隐藏或更改任何视图、配套文件、比较组或结果。元数据匹配不代表身份认证、采集内容标识或新的完整性结论。');box.append(p);
  const table=document.createElement('table'),head=document.createElement('thead'),tr=document.createElement('tr');for(const text of [t('View / filename','视图／文件名称'),t('Retained source SHA-256','保留的源文件SHA-256'),t('Bytes / sharing views','字节数／共享视图数'),t('Comparison scope','比较范围')]){const th=document.createElement('th');th.scope='col';th.textContent=text;tr.append(th);}head.append(tr);table.append(head);const body=document.createElement('tbody');
  for(const row of snapshot(RUNS)){const tr=document.createElement('tr');let column=0;for(const value of [row.view+' · '+row.filename,row.source_sha256||t('Unavailable','不可用'),(row.source_bytes===null?t('Unavailable','不可用'):String(row.source_bytes))+' / '+(row.match_view_count===null?t('Unavailable','不可用'):row.match_view_count),state(row.comparison_state)+(row.byte_count_state==='incomplete'?' · '+t('Byte-count evidence incomplete','字节数记录不完整'):'')]){const td=document.createElement('td');td.setAttribute('data-label',head.firstChild.children[column++].textContent);td.textContent=value;tr.append(td);}body.append(tr);}table.append(body);box.append(table);
  const button=document.createElement('button');button.type='button';button.textContent=t('Download source identity comparison (CSV)','下载源文件标识比较（CSV）');button.onclick=()=>download('source_identity_comparison.csv',csvOf(rows(RUNS)),'text/csv');box.append(button);
 }
 MISSY_HOOKS.use('showTab','source-matches/metadata-only',268,next=>function(...args){const result=next(...args);render();return result;});
 const style=document.createElement('style');style.textContent='#missy-source-matches{margin-top:16px;border-top:1px solid #d8dee8;padding-top:10px}#missy-source-matches[hidden]{display:none!important}#missy-source-matches summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:600}#missy-source-matches p{overflow-wrap:anywhere}#missy-source-matches table{width:100%;table-layout:fixed;border-collapse:collapse;margin:10px 0}#missy-source-matches th,#missy-source-matches td{padding:6px;text-align:left;vertical-align:top;overflow-wrap:anywhere;border-bottom:1px solid #d8dee8}#missy-source-matches button{max-width:100%;white-space:normal}@media(max-width:600px){#missy-source-matches table,#missy-source-matches tbody,#missy-source-matches tr,#missy-source-matches td{display:block;width:auto}#missy-source-matches thead{display:none}#missy-source-matches tr{border:1px solid #d8dee8;margin:8px 0}#missy-source-matches td{border:0}#missy-source-matches td::before{content:attr(data-label);display:block;font-weight:600}}';document.head.append(style);
 document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>{render();const loaded=document.getElementById('loaded');if(loaded)new MutationObserver(render).observe(loaded,{childList:true});new MutationObserver(render).observe(document.body,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class']});});
```

```javascript
function validateRunBoundary(run,source){
  const at=m=>new Error(`${source||"run"}: ${m}`);
  if(!run||typeof run!=="object")throw at("decoder returned no run object");
  if(!Array.isArray(run.wells))throw at("decoded object has no wells array");
  if(run.wells.length>APP_LIMITS.maxWellsPerRun)throw at(`${run.wells.length} wells exceeds the safety limit`);
  if(run.meta!=null&&(typeof run.meta!=="object"||Array.isArray(run.meta)))throw at("meta is not an object");
  const bad=run.wells.findIndex(w=>!w||typeof w!=="object"||Array.isArray(w));
  if(bad>=0)throw at(`well ${bad+1} is not an object`);
  return run;
}
```

```javascript
function xlsxCell(ref,v){
  if(v==null||v==="")return typeof v==="string"?`<c r="${ref}" t="inlineStr"><is><t></t></is></c>`:"";

}
```

```javascript
    {name:"xl/workbook.xml",data:`<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n<workbook xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main" xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships"><sheets>${wbSheets.join("")}</sheets></workbook>`},
    {name:"xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels",data:`<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">${rels.join("")}</Relationships>`},

}
```

```javascript
function drawTemperatureTrace(canvas,run){
  const L=run&&run.eds&&run.eds.log;if(!canvas||!L||!L.temps.length)return;
  const ctx=canvas.getContext("2d"),W=canvas.width,H=canvas.height,Lm=60,R=20,T=18,B=44,t0=L.temps[0][0];
  const xs=L.temps.map(t=>(t[0]-t0)/60000),xmax=Math.max(...xs)||1,vals=L.temps.flatMap(t=>[t[1],t[2]]).filter(Number.isFinite);
  const lo=Math.min(0,...vals),hi=Math.max(...vals)+2,X=x=>Lm+x/xmax*(W-Lm-R),Y=v=>T+(hi-v)/(hi-lo)*(H-T-B);
  ctx.fillStyle="#fff";ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);ctx.font="11px sans-serif";ctx.fillStyle="#64748b";ctx.textAlign="right";
  for(let i=0;i<=5;i++){const v=lo+(hi-lo)*i/5,y=Y(v);ctx.strokeStyle="#e5e7eb";ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(Lm,y);ctx.lineTo(W-R,y);ctx.stroke();ctx.fillText(v.toFixed(0),Lm-6,y+3);}
  ctx.textAlign="center";for(let i=0;i<=6;i++){const x=xmax*i/6;ctx.fillText(x.toFixed(0),X(x),H-B+16);}
  ctx.fillText(ui("Minutes from the first log record"),(Lm+W-R)/2,H-8);
  ctx.save();ctx.translate(14,(T+H-B)/2);ctx.rotate(-Math.PI/2);ctx.fillText("°C",0,0);ctx.restore();
  [[1,"#1f6feb"],[2,"#d97706"],[4,"#6f42c1"]].forEach(([k,c])=>{ctx.strokeStyle=c;ctx.lineWidth=1.3;ctx.beginPath();
    L.temps.forEach((t,i)=>{const v=t[k];if(!Number.isFinite(v))return;const x=X(xs[i]),y=Y(v);i?ctx.lineTo(x,y):ctx.moveTo(x,y);});ctx.stroke();});
}
```

```javascript
function qsWorkbook(run,opt){

  if(opt&&opt.pseudo)head.push(["Sample Names","pseudonymised by the exporting page"]);

    const body=s.rows.map(r=>{const a=s.cols.map(c=>r[c]===undefined?null:r[c]);if(s.ragged)while(a.length>3&&a[a.length-1]==null)a.pop();return a;});
    return {name:s.name,rows:[...head,[],[],s.cols,...body,...(s.tail||[])]};
  }));
}
```

## C05249 · decodeProtocol

- Ownership: MISSY first-party
- Module: readers/ixo/decode.js, line 196; script 8, script line 1594
- Form: FunctionDeclaration; parameters: `dom`
- AST classification: `current_matching_baseline_ast`
- R1 entry status: `observed_in_passing_scenario`
- Passing scenario observations: formats, evidence-keyboard
- R2 clean contract evidence: No separately linked clean contract assertion for this function
- Code SHA-256: `e866f3ab83d560aae13971ac5222b02d78a964295aeb35d15966d7c0c7299afb`
- [Complete exact function source](https://github.com/mihaiionitabio-alt/zpcrweb/blob/missy-public-offline-2026-10-20/documentation/releases/2026-10-31-full-wiki/code/functions/C05249.js)

```javascript
function decodeProtocol(dom){
  const programs=[];
  dom.querySelectorAll('[class="HTCRunProgram"]').forEach(el=>{
    const segs=[...el.querySelectorAll('[class="HTCRunSegment"]')].map(s=>({
      target:Number(pv(s,"Target")),target2:Number(pv(s,"Target2")),hold:Number(pv(s,"Hold")),
      slope:Number(pv(s,"Slope")),acqMode:pv(s,"AcquisitionMode"),acqPerDeg:pv(s,"AcqPerDegree"),
      stepSize:Number(pv(s,"StepSize")),stepDelay:Number(pv(s,"StepDelay"))
    }));
    programs.push({name:pv(el,"name"),cycles:Number(pv(el,"Cycles")),mode:pv(el,"AnalysisMode"),segments:segs});
  });
  /* Only the run's embedded detection format defines acquisition indices.
     The DetectionFormats object may also carry a complete instrument catalogue;
     its Active flags describe formats, not channels acquired by this run. */
  const formats=[...dom.querySelectorAll('[class="HTCDetectionFormat"]')];
  const embedded=formats.filter(f=>f.getAttribute("name")==="DetFormat"
    &&f.closest('[class="TCyclingInput"]'));
  const selectedName=propText(dom,"DefFormatName")||"";
  const candidates=embedded.length?embedded:formats.filter(f=>pv(f,"name")===selectedName);
  const signature=f=>JSON.stringify([...f.querySelectorAll('[class="HTCChannel"]')]
    .filter(c=>pv(c,"Active")==="1").map(c=>[pv(c,"ExcitationWL"),pv(c,"EmissionWL")]));
  if(candidates.length&&new Set(candidates.map(signature)).size!==1)
    throw new Error("Ambiguous acquisition channels: embedded detection formats disagree");
  if(formats.length&&!candidates.length)
    throw new Error("Cannot resolve the run's acquisition detection format; catalogue channels were not used");
  const channelRoot=candidates[0]||dom;
  const channels=[];
  channelRoot.querySelectorAll('[class="HTCChannel"]').forEach(el=>{
    const c={name:pv(el,"name"),active:pv(el,"Active")==="1",em:Number(pv(el,"EmissionWL")),ex:Number(pv(el,"ExcitationWL")),
      integr:Number(pv(el,"IntgrTime")),maxIntegr:Number(pv(el,"MaxIntgrTime")),
      meltFactor:pv(el,"MeltFactor"),quantFactor:pv(el,"QuantFactor")};
    channels.push(c);
  });
  const bt=dom.querySelector('[class="HTCBlockType"]');
  const block=bt?{
    id:pv(bt,"Id"),rowCount:Number(pv(bt,"RowCount")),colCount:Number(pv(bt,"ColCount")),
    rampUp:Number(pv(bt,"RampRateMaxUp")),rampDn:Number(pv(bt,"RampRateMaxDn")),
    volMin:Number(pv(bt,"ReactionVolMin")),volMax:Number(pv(bt,"ReactionVolMax")),
    volDefault:Number(pv(bt,"ReactionVolDefault"))
  }:null;
  const numOrNull=t=>{const v=propText(dom,t);return v===""?null:Number(v);};
  const setup={
    channelCount:numOrNull("ChannelCount"),subclass:propText(dom,"InstrumentSubclass"),
    seekTemp:numOrNull("SeekTemp"),maxPositions:numOrNull("MaxPositionsToSeek"),
    sampleVolume:numOrNull("SampleVolume"),plateId:propText(dom,"PlateID")
  };
  const detectionFormatName=propText(dom,"DefFormatName")||"";
  const analysisModes=[...dom.querySelectorAll('list[name="AnalysisModes"] prop, list[name="AnalysisModes"] item')]
    .map(e=>(e.textContent||"").trim()).filter(Boolean);
  return {programs,channels,block,setup,detectionFormatName,analysisModes:uniq(analysisModes),
    hasTemperatureLog:!!dom.querySelector('[class="TemperatureLog"]')};
}
```

```javascript
  if("CrossingPoint" in d)return "quant";
  if("TargetCpMedian" in d||"NormRatio" in d||"ConcRatio" in d)return "relquant";
  /* Gene Scanning and Melt Curve Genotype records also contain TmCount and Tms

}
```

```javascript
function decodeRelQuant(an){
  const genes=[...an.querySelectorAll('[class="RelQuantData"]')].map(g=>{
    const gi=g.querySelector('[class="GeneInfo"]'),cr2=gi&&gi.querySelector('[class="ChannelRatio"]');
    return {
      name:gi?pv(gi,"RQTargetName"):"",
      type:gi?pv(gi,"RQDataType"):"",
      isTarget:(gi?pv(gi,"RQDataType"):"")==="dtTarget",
      external:gi?pv(gi,"ExternalData")==="1":false,
      ex:cr2?Number(pv(cr2,"NumeratorXWL")):null,em:cr2?Number(pv(cr2,"NumeratorEWL")):null,
      positions:[...g.querySelectorAll('[class="TIntegerList"] > list > prop')].map(x=>Number(x.textContent))
    };
  });
  const posList=el=>[...el.querySelectorAll('[class="PairSampleInfo"]')]
    .map(x=>({pos:Number(pv(x,"BasePosition")),gene:Number(pv(x,"RQDataIndex")),channel:Number(pv(x,"RQChannelIndex"))}));
  const pairings=[...an.querySelectorAll('[class="Pairing"]')].map(p=>({
    name:pv(p,"name"),
    calibTarget:posList(p.querySelector(':scope > obj[name="CalibTarget"]')||p),
    calibRef:posList(p.querySelector(':scope > obj[name="CalibRef"]')||p),
    pairTarget:posList(p.querySelector(':scope > obj[name="PairTarget"]')||p),
    pairRef:posList(p.querySelector(':scope > obj[name="PairRef"]')||p)
  }));
  const targets=genes.filter(g=>g.isTarget),refs=genes.filter(g=>!g.isTarget);
  const groups=[...an.querySelectorAll('[class="ResultGroup"]')].map((g,i)=>{
    const unknowns=[...g.querySelectorAll('[class="UnkResult"]')].map(x=>rqResult(x,false));
    /* which genes this group compared: read it from the pairings it names, and fall back
       to the declaration order of the target genes */
    const named=new Set(unknowns.map(u=>u.pairName));
    const mine=pairings.filter(p=>named.has(p.name));
    const gi=mine.length&&mine[0].pairTarget.length?mine[0].pairTarget[0].gene:null;
    const ri=mine.length?uniq(mine[0].pairRef.map(x=>x.gene)):[];
    return {
      hasCalib:pv(g,"HasCalib")==="1",
      target:(gi!=null&&genes[gi])?genes[gi].name:(targets[i]?targets[i].name:""),
      references:ri.length?ri.map(x=>genes[x]?genes[x].name:"").filter(Boolean):refs.map(x=>x.name),
      calib:rqResult(g.querySelector('[class="CalibResult"]'),true),
      unknowns
    };
  });
  return {
    genes,targets:targets.map(g=>g.name),references:refs.map(g=>g.name),pairings,groups,
    rule:PAIRING_RULES[pv(an,"PairingRule")]||pv(an,"PairingRule"),
    ruleCode:pv(an,"PairingRule"),
    manualPairing:pv(an,"ManualPairing")==="1",
    multiTarget:pv(an,"MultiTarget")==="1",
    correction:pv(an,"CorrectionFactor"),multiplication:pv(an,"MultiplicationFactor")
  };
}
```

```javascript
function decodeAnalyses(dom){
  const out=[];
  const seenEl=new Set();
  dom.querySelectorAll('obj[class]').forEach(an=>{
    const cls=an.getAttribute("class")||"";
    if(!ANALYSIS_CLASS_RE.test(cls))return;
    if(/^(AnalysisList|TAnalysisSampleList|AnalysisSamples)$/i.test(cls))return;
    if(!an.querySelector(':scope > prop[name="name"]'))return;
    if(seenEl.has(an))return;seenEl.add(an);
    const name=pv(an,"name");
    const {kind,label}=analysisKind(cls,name);
    const sc=ownQuery(an,'[class="StdCurve"]');
    const stats=ownQueryAll(an,'[class="QuantStat"]').map(s=>({
      sampleIds:pv(s,"SampleIDs"),count:Number(pv(s,"SampleCount")),master:pv(s,"SampleMaster"),
      cpAvg:Number(pv(s,"CpAverage")),cpSD:Number(pv(s,"CpDeviation")),
      concAvg:Number(pv(s,"ConcAverage")),concSD:Number(pv(s,"ConcDeviation")),method:pv(s,"StatMethod")
    }));
    const genotypeGroups=uniq(ownQueryAll(an,'[class="GenotypeGroup"]')
      .map(g=>pv(g,"name")).filter(Boolean));
    /* "Subordinate for Target 1\\465-510\\Samples+Calibrator" is the per-gene quantification a
       relative quantification analysis runs internally; the gene is the first path segment. */
    const subsetRaw=pv(an,"SubsetName");
    const subordinate=/^Subordinate for /i.test(name);
    const geneName=subsetRaw.indexOf("\\")>=0?subsetRaw.split("\\")[0].trim():"";
    const cr=ownQuery(an,'[class="ChannelRatio"]');
    const xwl=cr?pv(cr,"NumeratorXWL"):"",dwl=cr?pv(cr,"DenominatorXWL"):"";
    /* the settings that define how this analysis produced its crossing points */
    const numOr=(t,el)=>{const v=pv(el||an,t);return v===""?null:Number(v);};
    const settings={
      mode:pv(an,"Mode"),measuringMode:pv(an,"MeasuringMode"),
      firstCycle:numOr("FirstCycle"),lastCycle:numOr("LastCycle"),
      backgroundStart:numOr("BackgroundStart"),backgroundStop:numOr("BackgroundStop"),
      noiseband:numOr("Noiseband"),noisebandMethod:pv(an,"NoisebandMethod"),
      stdDevMultiplier:numOr("StdDevMultiplier"),numFitPoints:numOr("NumFitPoints"),
      threshold:numOr("Threshold"),thresholdMethod:pv(an,"ThresholdMethod"),
      selectedProgram:pv(an,"SelectedProgram"),colourCompensation:pv(an,"IsCCCEnabled")==="1"
    };
    const ewl=cr?pv(cr,"NumeratorEWL"):"",dewl=cr?pv(cr,"DenominatorEWL"):"";
    out.push({
      cls,kind,kindLabel:label,
      name,shortName:pv(an,"shortname"),uid:pv(an,"UID"),
      created:pv(an,"Created"),modified:pv(an,"LastModified"),
      createdBy:pv(an,"CreatedByName"),modifiedBy:pv(an,"LastModifiedByName"),
      calcState:calcStateLabel(pv(an,"CalcState")),rawCalcState:pv(an,"CalcState"),cccEnabled:pv(an,"IsCCCEnabled")==="1",
      cpMethod:cpMethodOf(name,cls),
      subordinate,geneName,
      notes:pv(an,"Notes"),
      relQuant:kind==="relquant"?decodeRelQuant(an):null,
      subsetName:geneName||subsetRaw,rawSubsetName:subsetRaw,
      numeratorXWL:xwl===""?null:parseInt(xwl,10),
      numeratorEWL:ewl===""?null:parseInt(ewl,10),
      denominatorXWL:(dwl===""||dwl==="0")?null:parseInt(dwl,10),
      denominatorEWL:(dewl===""||dewl==="0")?null:parseInt(dewl,10),
      maxPos:Number(pv(an,"MaxPosSamples"))||null,
      settings,
      genotypeGroups,
      stdCurve:sc?{method:pv(sc,"Method"),curveType:pv(sc,"CurveType"),state:pv(sc,"State"),
        extAnchor:pv(sc,"ExtStdRqAnchor"),
        source:pv(sc,"CurveType")==="ctExternal"?"external"
              :pv(sc,"CurveType")==="ctInternal"?"in-run"
              :pv(sc,"CurveType")==="ctEfficiency"?"assumed efficiency":pv(sc,"CurveType"),
        assumedEfficiency:pv(sc,"CurveType")==="ctEfficiency",
        standards:[...sc.querySelectorAll('[class="StdCrvSam"]')].map(x=>({
          name:pv(x,"name"),wellText:pv(x,"PosAsStr"),pos:Number(pv(x,"Position")),
          cq:Number(pv(x,"CrossingPoint")),conc:Number(pv(x,"Concentration")),
          call:pv(x,"Call"),targetName:pv(x,"TargetName")})),
        fitError:Number(pv(sc,"FitError")),efficiency:Number(pv(sc,"Efficiency")),
        slope:Number(pv(sc,"Slope")),yIntercept:Number(pv(sc,"YIntercept")),
        curveEff:Number(pv(sc,"CurveEff")),linkConc:pv(sc,"LinkConc"),
        nStandards:sc.querySelectorAll('obj[name="Standard Samples"] list > obj').length}:null,
      quantStats:stats,el:an
    });
  });
  /* an analysis nested inside another belongs to it: a relative quantification analysis owns
     one subordinate quantification per gene, and those must stay distinguishable */
  out.forEach(a=>{
    let p=a.el.parentElement,parent=null;
    while(p&&!parent){
      parent=out.find(x=>x!==a&&x.el===p)||null;
      p=p.parentElement;
    }
    a.parentName=parent?parent.name:"";
    a.parentUid=parent?parent.uid:"";
    a.parentKind=parent?parent.kind:"";
    if(a.subordinate&&a.parentName)a.shortName=a.parentName;
  });
  return out;
}
```

```javascript
function pcrdDecryptContainer(raw,check,password){
 if(raw.length<12)throw Error('PCRD encrypted payload is too short');
 let a=0x12345678,b=0x23456789,c=0x34567890;
 const update=n=>{a=(pcrdCRC_TABLE[(a^n)&255]^(a>>>8))>>>0;b=(Math.imul((b+(a&255))>>>0,134775813)+1)>>>0;c=(pcrdCRC_TABLE[(c^(b>>>24))&255]^(c>>>8))>>>0;};
 for(let i=0;i<password.length;i++)update(password.charCodeAt(i)&255);
 const result=new Uint8Array(raw.length-12);let last=0;
 for(let i=0;i<raw.length;i++){const t=(c|2)&65535,n=raw[i]^((Math.imul(t,t^1)>>>8)&255);update(n);if(i<12)last=n;else result[i-12]=n;}
 if(last!==check){pcrdForgetPassword();throw Error('REVIEW: incorrect PCRD password or damaged file. No measurements imported; retry with the correct password.');}
 return result;
}
```

```javascript
function cfxNormalizeRDML(runs,text,name,bytes){if(!runs.some(r=>/BioRadCFXManager|Bio-Rad.*CFX/i.test(r.meta.SWVersion)))return runs;const doc=new DOMParser().parseFromString(text,'application/xml'),root=doc.documentElement,dyes=rdmlKids(root,'dye').map(x=>x.getAttribute('id')),binding=CFX_RDML_BINDINGS.get(bytes)||{},entry=binding.entry;
 for(const r of runs){const exp=rdmlKids(root,'experiment').find(x=>x.getAttribute('id')===r.experimentId),el=rdmlKids(exp,'run').find(x=>x.getAttribute('id')===r.runId);const dye=dyes.filter(d=>r.runId.endsWith('_'+d)).sort((a,b)=>b.length-a.length)[0]||'',channel=Math.max(0,dyes.indexOf(dye)),serial=/Cycler SN:\s*([^,;\r\n]+)/i.exec(r.rdmlDoc.instrument)?.[1]?.trim()||'';const info=entry?.metadata?.runInfo||{};
  r.cfxRDML={sha256:binding.sha256||'',source:entry||null,dye,protocolSHA256:entry?.protocolSHA256||'',protocolXML:rdmlKids(root,'thermalCyclingConditions').map(x=>x.outerHTML).join(''),provenanceStatus:entry?'Local export manifest linked by exact RDML SHA-256':'REVIEW: original PCRD provenance manifest unavailable',issues:[]};
  if(info.BaseSerialNumber&&serial&&info.BaseSerialNumber!==serial)r.cfxRDML.issues.push('Conflicting instrument serial sources');r.meta.SerialNumber=serial||info.BaseSerialNumber||'';r.meta.InstrumentID=r.meta.SerialNumber;r.meta.sourceSHA256=binding.sha256||'';r.meta.Platform='CFX RDML';r.platform='CFX RDML';if(info.RunStartTime&&!r.meta.StartTime)r.meta.StartTime=r.meta.RunCreated=info.RunStartTime;
  const mapped=[];for(const react of rdmlKids(el,'react'))for(const d of rdmlKids(react,'data'))mapped.push({pos:Number(react.getAttribute('id'))-1,d});
  for(const [i,w]of r.wells.entries()){const d=mapped[i]?.d;if(!d||mapped[i].pos!==w.pos)throw Error('CFX RDML reaction alignment error');w.rdml.originalTargetId=w.target;w.rdml.amplification=rdmlKids(d,'adp').map(a=>[rdmlNum(a,'cyc'),rdmlNum(a,'fluor')]).filter(p=>p.every(Number.isFinite)).sort((a,b)=>a[0]-b[0]);w.CpRaw=w.Cp=rdmlNum(d,'cq');w.cqAtCycleCeiling=false;w.callCode=w.Cp===null?0:1;w.CpState=w.CrossingPointStatus=w.Cp===null?'Undetermined':'';w.filterName=dye||'Unassigned dye';w.channel=channel;if(!w.target)w.target=w.targetName='Unassigned target'+(dye?' · '+dye:'');w.analysisShort=w.target;w.analysisUid='cfx:'+w.target;w.analysis='CFX RDML · '+w.target;const alias=entry?.aliases?.find(a=>Number(a.well_position)===w.pos&&(a.fluor===dye));w.rdml.exportAlias=alias||null;mapped[i].w=w;}
  r.rdmlDoc.cqAtCycleCeiling=0;for(const rec of Object.values(r.plate))rec.channels={};for(const w of r.wells){r.plate[w.pos].channels[w.channel]={sampleType:w.instrType,targetName:w.target,targetType:w.targetType};}r.allCurves={};for(const w of r.wells)if(w.curve.length)r.allCurves[channel+'|'+w.pos]={channel,pos:w.pos,curve:w.curve,amplitude:Math.max(...w.curve)-Math.min(...w.curve)};
  for(const w of r.tmWells){w.channel=channel;const original=w.target;w.target=original||'Unassigned target'+(dye?' · '+dye:'');}
  r.analyses=[...new Set(r.wells.map(w=>w.target))].map(t=>({name:'CFX RDML · '+t,shortName:t,uid:'cfx:'+t,kind:'absquant',kindLabel:'Vendor RDML export',channelIdx:channel,channelName:dye,filterName:dye,calcState:'exported',settings:{},quantStats:[],stdCurve:null}));
 }return runs;
}
```

```javascript
async function decodeZpcr(source){
 const bytes=source.bytes,ab=bytes.buffer.slice(bytes.byteOffset,bytes.byteOffset+bytes.byteLength),z=await ZPCR.parseZpcr(ab);
 if(!z.reads.length)throw Error('REVIEW: no plate reads in this ZPCR');
 if(z.archive.names.filter(n=>/\.plateread$/i.test(n)).length!==z.reads.length)throw Error('REVIEW: one or more plate reads could not be decoded: '+z.issues.join('; '));
 if(z.grid.referenceRows===null)throw Error('REVIEW: sample/reference boundary is not established');
 if(z.grid.sampleRows!==8||z.grid.cols!==12)throw Error('REVIEW: this importer currently supports 96-well CFX geometry only');
 const first=z.reads[0];if(z.reads.some(r=>r.rows!==first.rows||r.cols!==first.cols||r.channels!==first.channels))throw Error('REVIEW: conflicting acquisition geometries');
 const meta={ZPCRProtocolSHA256:await sourceSha256(new TextEncoder().encode(z.protocolText||'')),name:source.name,InstrumentName:'Bio-Rad CFX '+(z.instrument.block||''),InstrumentID:z.instrument.base||'',SerialNumber:z.instrument.base||'',StartTime:z.runInfo.RunStartTime||'',SWVersion:'',InstrumentVersion:z.instrument.firmware||'',MacroName:'',Notes:'Raw acquisition only; no Cq, Tm, dye unmixing or sample calls. REVIEW.',Platform:'Bio-Rad ZPCR',sourceSHA256:await sourceSha256(bytes),sourceBytes:bytes.length};
 const allCurves={},plate={}; // Raw multi-step curves live in the isolated ZPCR view, never synthetic results.
 for(let pos=0;pos<96;pos++)plate[pos]={name:'',sampleId:'',notes:'Sample identity not decoded',channels:{},subsets:[]};
 const steps=[...new Set(z.reads.map(r=>r.step))];
 return {file:source.name,sourcePath:source.path||source.name,sourceArchive:source.archive||null,zip:source.zip||null,meta,platform:'Bio-Rad ZPCR',zpcr:z,rawOnly:true,wells:[],tmWells:[],genoResults:[],rqResults:[],otherResults:[],allCurves,plate,subsets:[],analyses:[],nCycles:0,acqStats:[],acqError:null,acqMelt:null,acqSegments:[],acqAcquisitions:z.reads.length,acqScalingFactors:[],identities:{},duplicates:0,namedPositions:0,maxPos:96,cols:12,rows:8,blockId:z.instrument.block||'',kinds:[],format:{signature:'ZPCR / ICFF',version:String(first.version.plateread)},integrity:{kind:'zpcr',entries:z.archive.entries,crcVerified:!z.archive.encrypted.length,verifiedScope:'Decoded unencrypted members only',encrypted:z.archive.encrypted},protocol:{programs:steps.map(step=>({name:'Read step '+step,cycles:z.reads.filter(r=>r.step===step).length,mode:'Raw acquisition',segments:[]})),channels:Array.from({length:first.channels},(_,i)=>({name:'Raw channel '+(i+1),active:true,ex:'',em:'',filterSet:'',activityBasis:'Stored channel; mask uninterpreted'})),block:{rowCount:8,colCount:12},setup:{maxPositions:96},analysisModes:[],detectionFormatName:'Uncalibrated optical channels'}};
}
```

```javascript
function zpcrRows(run,kind){
 const z=run.zpcr,out=[];
 if(kind==='raw'){
  out.push(['source_sha256','file','member','scan_index','step','cycle','channel_1based','position_type','row_1based','column_1based','mean','sd','min','max']);
  for(const r of z.reads)for(let c=0;c<r.channels;c++)for(let row=0;row<r.rows;row++)for(let col=0;col<r.cols;col++){const w=ZPCR.zpcrWellStats(r,c,row,col);out.push([run.meta.sourceSHA256,run.file,r.name,r.scanIndex,r.step,r.cycle,c+1,row<z.grid.sampleRows?'sample':'reference',row+1,col+1,w.mean,w.sd,w.min,w.max]);}
 }else{
  out.push(['source_sha256','member','scan_index','step','cycle','timestamp','field','value','interpretation']);
  for(const r of z.reads){const add=(k,v,t)=>out.push([run.meta.sourceSHA256,r.name,r.scanIndex,r.step,r.cycle,r.dateText,k,v,t]);for(const [k,v]of Object.entries(r.temps))add(k,v.c,(v.kind==='setpoint'?'integer encoded; physical interpretation unresolved':v.kind+' interpretation')+'; degC');r.leds.forEach((v,c)=>add('LEDCURRENT'+(c+1),v,'DAC setting; not calibrated mA'));add('CHANNELMASK',r.channelMaskRaw,'verbatim; uninterpreted');add('ERRORNUMBER',r.errorNumber,'instrument code');for(let c=0;c<r.channels;c++){for(let k=0;k<4;k++)add('DARK.ch'+(c+1)+'.'+['mean','sd','min','max'][k],r.darkData?.[c*4+k]??'','raw detector counts');}}
 }
 return out;
}
```

```javascript
function sopNormalise(p){
  if(p&&p.schema==="qpcr-control-mapping-proposal/v1"){
    /* The review proposal intentionally has a different schema.  Opening it
       converts its reviewed SC-06 rules to the application profile shape;
       stored run values and calls remain untouched. */
    throw new Error("The retired SC control-mapping proposal is not a supported profile. Select or import a complete SOP profile.");
  }
  const b=sopBase();if(!p||typeof p!=="object")return b;
  const o=Object.assign({},b,p);
  ["replicates","ic","run","graphs"].forEach(k=>o[k]=Object.assign({},b[k],p[k]||{}));
  o.outcomes={};SOP_OUTCOMES.forEach(k=>o.outcomes[k]=Object.assign({},SOP_OUTCOME_DEFAULTS[k],(p.outcomes||{})[k]||{}));
  o.targets=Array.isArray(p.targets)&&p.targets.length?p.targets.map(t=>Object.assign({match:"*",kind:"auto",cqMax:40,cqLate:"",quantMin:"",lateOutcome:"Inconclusive"},t)):b.targets;
  o.controls=Array.isArray(p.controls)?p.controls.map(c=>Object.assign({name:"",matchBy:"name",match:"",expect:"negative",cqLo:"",cqHi:"",targets:"*",minPerRun:0,onFail:"reject"},c)):b.controls;
  // Repair only the two known escaped-string defects in saved SC-06 profiles.
  // Custom patterns and every acceptance limit remain unchanged.
  if(o.method&&o.method.id==="SOP-06-SC-screening"){
    const applies=o.method.applies_when||{};
    if(applies.run_name_pattern==="^SC(?:[_s-]|$)")o.method=Object.assign({},o.method,{applies_when:Object.assign({},applies,{run_name_pattern:"^SC(?:[_\\s-]|$)"})});
    if(o.sample_id&&o.sample_id.pattern==="^d+s*GMd{2}(?:\b|_)")o.sample_id=Object.assign({},o.sample_id,{pattern:"^\\d+\\s*GM\\d{2}(?:\\b|_)"});
  }
  o.schema=SOP_SCHEMA;delete o.sha256;return o;
}
```
